    import EweCore
    import EweWire
    import FlatBuffers
    import Foundation
    
    /// The socket carries one outbound request and a later reply for this screen.
    @MainActor public final class SocketActionConnection: HostTransport {
      public let requestTag: UInt64
      private var hello: Data?
      private var reconnect = false
      private var stream: UInt64?
      private var handle: (any ConnectionHandle)?
      private var waiting: CheckedContinuation<Data, Error>?
      private let timeout: Duration
      private let onReply: (Data) -> Void
      private let onError: (String) -> Void
    
      public init(manager: ConnectionManager, endpoint: URL, handshakeTimeout: Duration = .seconds(60),
        onReply: @escaping (Data) -> Void, onError: @escaping (String) -> Void) throws {
        self.requestTag = try manager.nextTag()
        self.timeout = handshakeTimeout
        self.onReply = onReply
        self.onError = onError
        handle = try manager.acquire("websocket", endpoint: endpoint, accept: { [weak self] in self?.accepts($0) ?? false },
          onOpen: { [weak self] in
            guard let self, reconnect, let hello else { return }
            reconnect = false
            Task { @MainActor in
              do { try await self.handle?.send(hello) } catch { self.onError(String(describing: error)) }
            }
          }, onError: { [weak self] cause in
            self?.reconnect = true
            self?.stream = nil
            self?.finish(.failure(CoreError.Transport(detail: cause)))
            self?.onError(cause)
          }, receive: { [weak self] in self?.receive($0) })
      }
    
      private func packet(_ data: Data) throws -> ewe_ui_Frame {
        var buffer = ByteBuffer(data: data)
        return try getCheckedRoot(byteBuffer: &buffer, fileId: "EWF1")
      }
    
      private func accepts(_ bytes: Data) -> Bool {
        guard let frame = try? packet(bytes), frame.kindType == .framemessage,
          let body = frame.kind(type: ewe_ui_FrameMessage.self) else { return false }
        if body.messagesCount > 0, let caps = body.messages(at: 0)?.control?.caps {
          return caps.requestTag == requestTag
        }
        return body.ack != 0 && stream == frame.streamId
      }
    
      private func receive(_ bytes: Data) {
        guard let frame = try? packet(bytes), let body = frame.kind(type: ewe_ui_FrameMessage.self) else { return }

    # Todo Server
    
    This app loads its first frame from the Rust server. Task changes go to the server.
    Open the add sheet and select filters on the device.
    
    From the repository root, run these commands.
    
    ```sh
    native-task task run native:todo:prepare-ios
    examples/ui_todo/build-module.sh
    cargo run --locked --profile uat -p ui_todo --bin ui_todo -- 127.0.0.1:8080
    ```
    
    Open `TodoServer.xcodeproj` in Xcode. Select an iPhone simulator, then run the `TodoServer` scheme.
    Set `EWE_TODO_URL` in the scheme's Run environment to use a different address.
    
    For a physical iPhone, select your team under Signing & Capabilities.
    Set `EWE_TODO_URL` to a server address that the iPhone can reach.
    Select the connected iPhone as the run destination. Run the same scheme.
    
    To test both iPhone apps on one simulator, run `native-task task run native:todo:test-ios SIMULATOR_ID` from the repository root.
    Get the simulator identifier with `xcrun simctl list devices available`.

    # Android todo apps
    
    Both apps use the [Ewe UI Android library](../../../mobile/android/README.md) and the same Rust todo actions and views.
    
    | App | Gradle project | Task store |
    |---|---|---|
    | [Todo Server](todo_server/) | `todo_server` | Store in the Rust server |
    | [Todo On Device](todo_on_device/) | `todo_on_device` | Store in the Android app |
    
    ## Build
    
    Run these commands from the repository root. The applications build independently and can install on the same emulator.
    
    ```sh
    mise run toolchain:android
    native-task task run native:bindings:sync-android
    native-task task run native:build-android --with-todo
    repo="$PWD/target/native-ui/maven"
    mise exec -- mobile/android/gradlew -p mobile/android publishToMavenLocal "-Dmaven.repo.local=$repo"
    for app in todo_server todo_on_device; do
      mise exec -- mobile/android/gradlew -p "examples/ui_todo/android/$app" "-PeweRepository=$repo" :app:assembleDebug
      adb install -r "examples/ui_todo/android/$app/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
    done
    ```
    
    Select one emulator in Android Debug Bridge (ADB) before installing. Run the example commands with `mise exec -- adb` when needed.
    The native build copies the application library to each app. Both apps compile the same generated application bindings from `generated/`.
    
    ## Test on a device
    
    The device test installs both apps on one emulator. It starts the local app before it starts a fresh Rust server.

    val vulkanTestHost = tasks.register("compileVulkanTestHost") {
        val source = file("src/androidTest/cpp/host_vulkan.cpp")
        val headers = project(":binding").file("src/main/assets/include")
        inputs.file(source)
        inputs.dir(headers)
        outputs.dir(vulkanTestLibs)
        doLast {
            val ndk = System.getenv("ANDROID_NDK_HOME")?.let { file(it) } ?: androidComponents.sdkComponents.sdkDirectory.get().asFile.resolve("ndk").listFiles()?.filter { it.isDirectory }?.maxByOrNull { it.name }
            requireNotNull(ndk) { "The Vulkan device test needs the Android NDK" }
            val toolchain = ndk.resolve("toolchains/llvm/prebuilt").listFiles()!!.first { it.isDirectory }.resolve("bin")
            for ((abi, triple) in mapOf("arm64-v8a" to "aarch64-linux-android", "x86_64" to "x86_64-linux-android")) {
                val output = vulkanTestLibs.get().dir(abi).asFile
                output.mkdirs()
                val windows = System.getProperty("os.name").startsWith("Windows")
                val compiler = toolchain.resolve(triple + "26-clang++" + if (windows) ".cmd" else "")
                val args = listOf(compiler.path, "-std=c++17", "-shared", "-fPIC", "-static-libstdc++", "-DVK_USE_PLATFORM_ANDROID_KHR", "-I"+headers.path,
                    source.path, "-lvulkan", "-landroid", "-ldl", "-o", output.resolve("libewe_gpu_test_host.so").path)
                check(ProcessBuilder(args).inheritIO().start().waitFor() == 0) { "Failed to build Vulkan test host for $abi" }
            }
        }
    }

      func testAddTaskToFreshServerStore() {
        let app = XCUIApplication()
        app.launchEnvironment["EWE_TODO_URL"] =
          ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EWE_TODO_URL"] ?? "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
        app.launchEnvironment["EWE_TODO_SOCKET"] = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EWE_TODO_SOCKET"]
        app.launchEnvironment["EWE_TODO_RPC"] = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EWE_TODO_RPC"]
        app.launch()
        let add = app.navigationBars["Todos"].buttons["Add"]
        XCTAssertTrue(add.waitForExistence(timeout: 20))
        XCTAssertFalse(app.staticTexts["Device-only task"].exists)
        add.tap()
        let input = app.textFields["Todo title"]
        XCTAssertTrue(input.waitForExistence(timeout: 5))
        input.tap()
        input.typeText("Server integration task\n")
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Server integration task"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["1 open todo"].waitForExistence(timeout: 5))
        app.buttons["Complete"].tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.buttons["Reopen"].waitForExistence(timeout: 5))
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["0 open todos"].waitForExistence(timeout: 5))
        app.buttons["Reopen"].tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["1 open todo"].waitForExistence(timeout: 5))
      }
    }

    mobile.rs
    import CryptoKit
    import EweTodoCore
    import EweUI
    import SwiftUI
    
    @main struct TodoServerApp: App {
      private let theme = Result {
        if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EWE_TODO_THEME"] == "branded" {
          return try EweTheme(manifest: Data(todoThemeManifest().utf8))
        }
        return EweTheme()
      }
    
      private func actionTransport(_ base: URL) -> ActionTransport {
        let environment = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
        if environment["EWE_TODO_RPC"] == "1" { return .connect(base) }
        if environment["EWE_TODO_SOCKET"] == "1" { return .webSocket(base.appendingPathComponent("socket")) }
        return .http
      }
    
      var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup {
          switch theme {
          case .failure(let error): Text(error.localizedDescription)
          case .success(let theme):
            let address = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EWE_TODO_URL"] ?? "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
            if let url = URL(string: address) {
              let key = SHA256.hash(data: Data(url.absoluteString.utf8)).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
              let file = URL.applicationSupportDirectory.appending(path: "TodoPending/\(key).json").path
              ServerScreen(base: url, initial: "initial", transport: actionTransport(url), theme: theme) { transport, store in
                let core = try createPersistentTodoCore(platform: .ios, transport: transport, storageFile: file)
                core.installResources(source: BundleResourceSource())
                return NativeActionCore(core, store: store, viewDataAction: "host:apply_todo_delivery")
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    """Check the two visible Android todo screens and their independent stores."""
    
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import time
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    
    adb, device, phase, *labels = sys.argv[1:]
    app = "ewe.todo" if phase.startswith(("server", "peer-")) else "ewe.todo.local"
    timeout = int(os.getenv("EWE_ANDROID_VIEW_TIMEOUT", "60"))
    
    
    def shell(*args, command_timeout=10):
        return subprocess.check_output(
            [adb, "-s", device, "shell", *args], text=True, timeout=command_timeout
        )
    
    
    def wait_for(*present, absent=(), condition=lambda _: True):
        snapshot = "/sdcard/ewe-todo.xml"
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        visible = {}
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                report = shell("uiautomator", "dump", snapshot)
                if snapshot not in report:
                    continue
                nodes = list(ET.fromstring(shell("cat", snapshot)).iter("node"))
                visible = {
                    node.get("text"): node
                    for node in nodes
                    if node.get("package") == app and node.get("text")
                }
                for node in nodes:
                    if node.get("package") == app:
                        if node.get("content-desc"):
                            visible.setdefault(node.get("content-desc"), node)
                        if node.get("class") == "android.widget.EditText":
                            visible.setdefault("<editor>", node)
                if all(label in visible for label in present) and all(label not in visible for label in absent) and condition(visible):
                    return visible
            except (ET.ParseError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.5)
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{app} expected {present} and absent {absent}. Visible: {list(visible)}"
        )
    
    
    def tap(text, *also_visible):
        node = wait_for(text, *also_visible)[text]
        left, top, right, bottom = map(int, re.findall(r"-?\d+", node.attrib["bounds"]))
        shell("input", "tap", str((left + right) // 2), str((top + bottom) // 2), command_timeout=timeout)
    
    
    def create(title):
        tap("Add", "Todos")
        tap("Todo title", "New todo")
        shell("input", "text", title.replace(" ", "%s"), command_timeout=timeout)
        tap("Add", "New todo")
        wait_for(title, absent=("New todo",))

    //! Run the independent starter or the two Todo apps on Android.
    use super::{
        device::{self, cleanup, cleanup_command, text},
        stage, NativeBuildEnv,
    };
    use clap::Args;
    use foundation_tasks::{ProcessCommand, TaskContext, TaskEnv, TaskError, TaskResult};
    use std::{
        collections::BTreeMap,
        ffi::OsString,

        net::TcpListener,
        path::{Path, PathBuf},
        time::Duration,
    };
    
    #[derive(Args)]
    pub(super) struct Options {
        #[arg(long)]
        maven: Option<PathBuf>,
    }
    pub(super) async fn starter(ctx: TaskContext, args: Options) -> TaskResult {
        run(&ctx, args, false).await
    }
    pub(super) async fn todo(ctx: TaskContext, args: Options) -> TaskResult {
        run(&ctx, args, true).await
    }
    
    struct Device<'a> {
        ctx: &'a TaskContext,
        root: &'a Path,
        adb: PathBuf,
        serial: String,
        options: &'a device::Options,
    }
    impl Device<'_> {
        fn adb(&self) -> ProcessCommand {
            ProcessCommand::new(&self.adb)
                .current_dir(self.root)
                .args(["-s", &self.serial])
        }
        async fn ui(&self, mode: &str) -> TaskResult {
            self.ctx
                .exec(
                    ProcessCommand::new("python3")
                        .current_dir(self.root)
                        .arg("scripts/ui_native/check-android-todo.py")
                        .arg(&self.adb)
                        .args([&self.serial, mode]),
                )
                .await
        }
        async fn install(&self, apk: PathBuf) -> TaskResult {
            self.ctx
                .exec(self.adb().args(["install", "-r"]).arg(apk))
                .await
        }
        async fn start(&self, url: &str) -> TaskResult {
            let flag = |k| {
                self.options
                    .get(k)
                    .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("false")
            };
            self.ctx
                .exec(self.adb().args([
                    "shell",
                    "am",
                    "start",
                    "-n",
                    "ewe.todo/.MainActivity",
                    "--es",
                    "server",
                    url,
                    "--ez",
                    "rpc",
                    flag("EWE_TODO_RPC"),
                    "--ez",
                    "socket",
                    flag("EWE_TODO_SOCKET"),
                ]))
                .await
        }
        async fn instrument(&self, args: &[&str], expected: &str) -> TaskResult {
            let report = text(
                self.ctx,
                self.adb()
                    .args(["shell", "am", "instrument", "-w"])
                    .args(args.iter().copied())
                    .arg("ewe.todo.test/ewe.todo.ReplayCheck"),
            )
            .await?;
            if !report.contains(expected) {
                return Err(TaskError::operation(format!(
                    "Missing instrumentation result: {expected}"
                )));
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        async fn connected<F, Fut>(&self, url: String, work: F) -> TaskResult
        where
            F: FnOnce(String) -> Fut,
            Fut: std::future::Future<Output = TaskResult>,
        {
            let port = url
                .strip_prefix("http://127.0.0.1:")
                .and_then(|v| v.parse::<u16>().ok())
                .ok_or_else(|| TaskError::operation("Missing todo server port"))?;
            let endpoint = format!("tcp:{port}");
            self.ctx
                .exec(self.adb().args(["reverse", &endpoint, &endpoint]))
                .await?;
            let result = work(url).await;
            cleanup(
                result,
                cleanup_command(
                    self.ctx,
                    self.adb().args(["reverse", "--remove", &endpoint]),
                )
                .await,
            )
        }

    The example method belongs to the todo application binding. A missing identifier throws `TodoServiceException.NotFound`.
    To send UI actions through Connect, pass `rpcBase` to `RemoteEweScreen`.
    [Service setup and stream limits](../../backends/foundation_ui_connectrpc/README.md)
    
    ### Submit typed input
    
    A text control calls `bridge.send(EventId.SUBMIT, fieldId, value = "Buy milk")`.
    For a custom form, pass the value and its serializer to the event bridge.
    
    ```kotlin
    data class AddItem(val title: String, val listId: Long)
    bridge.sendStructured(EventId.SUBMIT, fieldId, AddItem("Buy milk", 7)) { item ->
        org.json.JSONObject().put("title", item.title).put("list_id", item.listId).toString()
    }
    ```
    
    The bridge keeps the state attached to this field. Rust decodes the payload as the declared action input.
    A remote host must negotiate vocabulary 9 or later.
    
    ## Send actions through a WebSocket
    
    Set the socket endpoint on the remote screen. The first view still loads over HTTP.
    
    ```kotlin
    RemoteEweScreen(
        endpoint, "initial",
        createCore = { transport -> createTodoCore(NativePlatform.ANDROID, transport) },
        socketEndpoint = "/socket",
    )
    ```
    
    The application library supplies `createTodoCore`. Its local action opens the form. Submit sends one binary remote action.
    A later socket message carries the reply for this screen. Reconnection negotiates capabilities again.
    print(item.title)
    ```
    
    The example method belongs to EweTodoCore. A missing identifier throws `TodoServiceError.NotFound`.
    A UI screen can separately select `ServerScreen(base:initial:rpcBase:session:theme:create:)` to send its actions through Connect.
    [Service setup and stream limits](../../backends/foundation_ui_connectrpc/README.md)
    
    ### Submit typed input
    
    A text control sends its own text through `bridge.send(.submit, node: fieldID, value: "Buy milk")`.
    For a custom form, define the payload and pass it to the same event bridge.
    
    ```swift
    struct AddItem: Encodable { let title: String; let list_id: UInt64 }
    try bridge.sendStructured(.submit, node: fieldID, value: AddItem(title: "Buy milk", list_id: 7))
    ```
    
    The bridge encodes the payload once and supplies the signed state attached to the field.
    Rust receives `Interaction<S, AddItem>`. A remote host must negotiate vocabulary 9 or later.
    
    ## Send actions through a WebSocket
    
    Supply the socket address to `ServerScreen`. The screen loads its initial view over HTTP.
    
    ```swift
    ServerScreen(base: base, initial: "initial", socket: base.appendingPathComponent("socket")) { transport, store in
        NativeActionCore(try createTodoCore(platform: .ios, transport: transport), store: store)
    }
    ```
    
    The example supplies `createTodoCore` from its application library. Its local action opens the form.
    The socket sends one binary request for a remote action. A later binary reply updates the originating screen.
    The screen negotiates capabilities again after a disconnect. The user can submit another action after negotiation.

    //! Build the native todo core with the same host actions and views as the browser.
    #[path = "mobile_pending.rs"]
    mod pending;
    use foundation_context::Ctx;
    use foundation_ui_native::{CoreError, EventInput, HostTransport, NativeCore, NativePlatform};
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    /// Returns the optional native theme from the shared Rust application.
    #[uniffi::export]
    pub fn todo_theme_manifest() -> String {
        crate::todo_theme().native_manifest()
    }
    
    /// Installs the presentation signer, local todo actions, and remote server declarations.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    /// Returns a setup error when an action declaration or signer is invalid.
    #[uniffi::export]
    pub fn create_todo_core(
        platform: NativePlatform,
        transport: Arc<dyn HostTransport>,
    ) -> Result<Arc<NativeCore>, CoreError> {
        remote_core(platform, transport, None)
    }
    
    /// Open a remote Todo screen with pending submissions in the application's private file.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    /// Returns an error if the host cannot install its services.
    #[uniffi::export]
    pub fn create_persistent_todo_core(
        platform: NativePlatform,
        transport: Arc<dyn HostTransport>,
        storage_file: String,
    ) -> Result<Arc<NativeCore>, CoreError> {
        remote_core(
            platform,
            transport,
            Some(std::path::PathBuf::from(storage_file)),
        )
    }
    
    fn remote_core(
        platform: NativePlatform,
        transport: Arc<dyn HostTransport>,
        path: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    ) -> Result<Arc<NativeCore>, CoreError> {
        let ctx = todo_context()?;
        if let Some(path) = path {
            crate::install_pending_storage(&ctx, Arc::new(pending::FileStorage(path)));
        }
        let registry = crate::host_registry().map_err(|e| CoreError::BadReference {
            detail: e.to_string(),
        })?;
        let sender = Arc::new(pending::Sender {
            ctx: ctx.clone(),
            transport,
            core: Default::default(),
        });
        let core = NativeCore::builder(platform, ctx, registry)
            .with_host_transport(sender.clone())
            .build();
        sender
            .core
            .set(Arc::downgrade(&core))
            .map_err(|_| CoreError::Write {
                detail: "Duplicate Todo sender".into(),
            })?;
        Ok(core)
    }
    
    /// Creates an on-device core and its task store.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    /// Returns an error if the signer or action declarations are invalid.
    #[uniffi::export]
    pub fn create_local_todo_core(platform: NativePlatform) -> Result<Arc<NativeCore>, CoreError> {
        let ctx = todo_context()?;
        let registry = crate::host_registry().map_err(|e| CoreError::BadReference {
            detail: e.to_string(),
        })?;
        Ok(NativeCore::builder(platform, ctx, registry).build())
    }
    
    /// Returns the first frame for an on-device screen.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    /// Returns an error if the core cannot render the first frame.
    #[uniffi::export]
    pub async fn initial_todo_frame(core: Arc<NativeCore>) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CoreError> {
        core.trigger("host:initialize_todos".into(), EventInput::receiving_view())
            .await?
            .ok_or_else(|| CoreError::Write {
                detail: "Missing initial todo frame".into(),
            })
    }
    
    fn todo_context() -> Result<Ctx, CoreError> {
        let ctx = Ctx::try_host().map_err(|e| CoreError::Write {
            detail: e.to_string(),
        })?;
        ctx.store(
            foundation_core::env::system(&ctx).map_err(|e| CoreError::Write {
                detail: e.to_string(),
            })?,
        );
        crate::install_cache(&ctx);
        crate::install_view_services(&ctx, foundation_ui_runtime::action::Origin::Host).map_err(
            |e| CoreError::Write {
                detail: e.to_string(),
            },
        )?;
        Ok(ctx)
    }

    //! Cross-platform WebSocket client (F51 Stage 6).
    //!
    //! WHY: F51 unifies the connection-owning client across native and wasm. The
    //! WebSocket client used to be `WebSocketClient<R: DnsResolver>` — native-only,
    //! parameterised over a resolver, and wired directly to the native
    //! `DrivenStreamIterator`. That baggage stopped it (and the transports built on
    //! it) from ever compiling to wasm. This module hosts the **platform-erased**
    //! client: no `R` generic, no native stream type in its signature.
    //!
    //! WHAT: [`WebSocketClient`] — a non-generic consumer over an already-spawned,
    //! boxed stream of inbound messages plus a [`MessageDelivery`] for outbound
    //! sends. Platform `connect` helpers (native: HTTP/1.1 Upgrade over the pool;
    //! wasm: the browser `WebSocket`) each build the boxed stream and hand it here
    //! via [`WebSocketClient::new`]. [`WebSocketEvent`] and the
    //! [`WebSocketMessageIterator`] present the same simple iterator surface as
    //! before.
    //!
    //! HOW: The inbound half is erased to `Box<dyn Iterator<Item =
    //! WebSocketStreamItem> + Send>` — the pending/progress context is collapsed to
    //! `()` because consumers only ever act on `Stream::Next`. The outbound half is
    //! the cross-platform [`MessageDelivery`] (a `PipeSender`), unchanged.
    
    use std::time::Duration;
    
    use foundation_core::valtron::{Pipe, PipeReceiver, PipeSender, Stream};
    
    use crate::shared::http::SimpleHeaders;
    
    use super::error::WebSocketError;
    use super::message::WebSocketMessage;
    
    /// Cross-platform connection progress reported while the stream is pending.
    ///
    /// WHY: The boxed stream needs a single, shared `Pending` type both targets can
    /// produce. Native maps its `WsPending` (single-shot + reconnecting task
    /// progress) into this; wasm maps the browser socket's `readyState`. Keeping a
    /// real progress enum (rather than erasing to `()`) preserves the connecting /
    /// handshaking / reconnecting signal a consumer can surface to a user.
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
    pub enum WsProgress {

                    match result {
                        Ok(WebSocketMessage::ConnectionEstablished) => Some(Ok(WebSocketEvent::Skip)),

                | Stream::Ignore
                | Stream::Pending(_)
                | Stream::Delayed(_)
                | Stream::Wait

    //! connection id). These are transport-scoped: built once where the connection

    }

            match self {

                Self::Ed25519(key) => write!(f, "ed25519:{} bytes", key.len()),

        pub peer_certificates: Vec<Vec<u8>>,

        pub server_name: Option<String>,
    }
    
    impl core::fmt::Display for TlsInfo {

    /// `connection.tls`, `connection.alpn`, … for per-connection facts that are
    /// shared across every request multiplexed on the connection.
    ///
    /// WHAT: The peer's network address and cryptographic identity, optional TLS
    /// details, the negotiated ALPN protocol id, and the QUIC/HTTP-3 0-RTT and
    /// connection-id fields.

    /// connection front end at accept/handshake time (HTTP/1.1 at accept, HTTP/2 and
    /// HTTP/3 at connection setup, WebSocket at upgrade). Wrapped in `Arc` by the
    /// request that carries it so cloning the request is a refcount bump.

        /// directly-built requests or browser-originated connections).
        pub peer_addr: Option<core::net::SocketAddr>,
        /// Peer cryptographic identity (iroh Ed25519 key / verified key), when known.
        pub peer_identity: PeerIdentity,
        /// TLS/mTLS negotiation details; `None` on cleartext connections.
        pub tls: Option<TlsInfo>,
        /// Negotiated ALPN protocol id (e.g. `b"h2"`, `b"http/1.1"`, `b"h3"`), if any.
        pub alpn: Option<Vec<u8>>,
        /// QUIC/HTTP-3 0-RTT early-data flag: the request arrived in early data.
        pub early_data: bool,
        /// QUIC connection id (HTTP/3 transports), when applicable.
        pub quic_connection_id: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    }
    
    impl ConnectionContext {
        /// Creates an empty connection context — no metadata known.
        ///
        /// The additive default used by callers that construct requests directly
        /// (tests, wasm client rendering); equivalent to [`Default::default`].
        #[must_use]
        pub fn empty() -> Self {
            Self::default()
        }
    
        /// Returns the negotiated ALPN protocol id as a UTF-8 string, if present and
        /// valid UTF-8 (ALPN ids are ASCII tokens in practice).
        #[must_use]
        pub fn alpn_str(&self) -> Option<&str> {
            self.alpn
                .as_deref()
                .and_then(|b| core::str::from_utf8(b).ok())
        }
    }
    
    impl core::fmt::Display for ConnectionContext {
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
            write!(f, "ConnectionContext(peer_identity={}", self.peer_identity)?;
            if let Some(addr) = &self.peer_addr {
                write!(f, ", peer_addr={addr:?}")?;
            }
            if let Some(tls) = &self.tls {
                write!(f, ", {tls}")?;
            }
            if let Some(alpn) = self.alpn_str() {
                write!(f, ", alpn={alpn}")?;
            }
            if self.early_data {
                write!(f, ", early_data")?;
            }
            write!(f, ")")
        }
    }

    //! [`WebSocketConnector`] impl for [`NativeHttpClient`] (F51 Stage 6).
    //!

    //! returns the cross-platform [`WebSocketClient`] or [`WsExchangeTask`] rather than
    //! a native-only connection type. That is what lets a caller write one call that

    //! headers, timeouts, and — native-only — reconnection).

    //! decides when to `valtron::execute()` it on their own pool — mirrors
    //! `HttpClient::open_exchange()`.

    struct PendingMapWsTask<I> {
        inner: I,

    impl<I> TaskIterator for PendingMapWsTask<I>
    where
        I: TaskIterator<Ready = Result<WebSocketMessage, WebSocketError>, Pending = WsPending>,

        type Pending = WsProgress;
    
        fn next_status(&mut self, ctx: Ctx) -> Option<TaskStatus<Self::Ready, Self::Pending>> {
            match self.inner.next_status(ctx)? {
                TaskStatus::Ready(d) => Some(TaskStatus::Ready(d)),
                TaskStatus::Pending(p) => Some(TaskStatus::Pending(native_progress(p))),
                TaskStatus::Spawn(s) => Some(TaskStatus::Spawn(s)),
                TaskStatus::Delayed(d) => Some(TaskStatus::Delayed(d)),
                TaskStatus::Init => Some(TaskStatus::Init),
                TaskStatus::Ignore => Some(TaskStatus::Ignore),
                TaskStatus::Wait => Some(TaskStatus::Wait),
                TaskStatus::Spread(items) => {
                    let mapped: Vec<_> = items
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|spread| match spread {
                            TaskSpread::Ready(d) => TaskSpread::Ready(d),
                            TaskSpread::Pending(p) => TaskSpread::Pending(native_progress(p)),
                        })
                        .collect();
                    Some(TaskStatus::Spread(mapped))
                }
                TaskStatus::Depends(ptr) => Some(TaskStatus::Depends(ptr)),
            }
        }
    }

    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use foundation_resources::{
        OpenFuture, ReadConfig, Resource, ResourceError, ResourceName, ResourceReader, Resources,

    /// A single package file. The application host closes each open file.
    #[uniffi::export(with_foreign)]
    pub trait HostResourceFile: Send + Sync {
        /// Return the next chunk. An empty chunk marks the end.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// Returns the operating system read error.
        fn read(&self, capacity: u32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CoreError>;
    
        /// Release this file.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// Returns the operating system close error.
        fn close_file(&self) -> Result<(), CoreError>;
    }
    
    /// The host opens files in its application bundle or asset manager.
    #[uniffi::export(with_foreign)]
    pub trait HostResourceSource: Send + Sync {
        /// Return an open file, or None when this name does not exist.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// Returns the operating system open error.
        fn open_resource_file(&self, name: String) -> Result<Option<Arc<dyn HostResourceFile>>, CoreError>;
    }
    
    struct File(Option<Arc<dyn HostResourceFile>>);
    impl File {
        fn close(&mut self) -> Result<(), CoreError> {
            self.0.take().map_or(Ok(()), |file| file.close_file())
        }
    }
    impl Drop for File {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            if let Err(error) = self.close() {
                tracing::warn!(%error, "Cannot close the package resource");
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// Adapts the host package file to a stream with bounded reads.
    pub struct MobileReader {
        source: Arc<dyn HostResourceSource>,
        config: ReadConfig,
    }
    impl MobileReader {
        #[must_use]
        pub fn new(source: Arc<dyn HostResourceSource>, config: ReadConfig) -> Self {
            Self { source, config }
        }
    }
    
    impl ResourceReader for MobileReader {
        fn open(&self, name: ResourceName) -> OpenFuture<'_> {
            let source = self.source.clone();
            let capacity = u32::try_from(self.config.chunk_bytes()).unwrap_or(u32::MAX);
            Box::pin(async move {
                let (file, name) = blocking::unblock(move || {
                    let file = source
                        .open_resource_file(name.as_str().into())
                        .map_err(|e| read_error(&name, e.to_string()))?
                        .ok_or_else(|| ResourceError::Missing {
                            name: name.as_str().into(),
                        })?;
                    Ok((File(Some(file)), name))
                })
                .await?;
                let stream = futures_util::stream::try_unfold(
                    (file, name),
                    move |(mut file, name)| async move {
                        blocking::unblock(move || {
                            let input = file.0.as_ref().expect("open file");
                            let bytes = input.read(capacity).map_err(|e| read_error(&name, e.to_string()))?;
                            if bytes.len() > capacity as usize {
                                return Err(read_error(&name, "host exceeded requested chunk size"));
                            }
                            if bytes.is_empty() {
                                file.close().map_err(|e| read_error(&name, e.to_string()))?;
                                return Ok(None);
                            }
                            Ok(Some((bytes, (file, name))))
                        })
                        .await
                    },
                );
                Ok(Box::pin(stream) as Resource)
            })
        }
    }
    fn read_error(name: &ResourceName, error: impl Into<String>) -> ResourceError {
        ResourceError::Read {
            name: name.as_str().into(),
            reason: error.into(),
        }
    }
    
    #[uniffi::export]
    impl NativeCore {
        /// Install this application's package resource reader before the first action.
        pub fn install_resources(&self, source: Arc<dyn HostResourceSource>) {
            Resources::install(
                &self.graphics_ctx,
                Arc::new(MobileReader::new(source, ReadConfig::default())),
            );
        }
    }
    
    /// A package stream that Swift or Kotlin can consume one chunk at a time.
    #[derive(uniffi::Object)]
    pub struct NativeResourceStream(futures_util::lock::Mutex<Resource>);
    
    #[uniffi::export]
    impl NativeResourceStream {
        /// Return the next chunk, or None at the end.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// Returns the package read error.
        pub async fn next_chunk(&self) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>, NativeResourceError> {
            use futures_util::StreamExt;
            self.0
                .lock()
                .await
                .next()
                .await
                .transpose()
                .map_err(Into::into)
        }
    }
    
    /// Resource failures that retain their type across the native language boundary.
    #[derive(Debug, uniffi::Error, derive_more::Display, derive_more::Error)]
    pub enum NativeResourceError {
        #[display("Invalid resource name: {name}")]
        InvalidName { name: String },
        #[display("The host has no package reader")]
        MissingHost,
        #[display("Resource {name} does not exist")]
        Missing { name: String },
        #[display("Cannot read {name}: {reason}")]
        Read { name: String, reason: String },
    }
    impl From<ResourceError> for NativeResourceError {
        fn from(error: ResourceError) -> Self {
            match error {
                ResourceError::InvalidName(error) => Self::InvalidName { name: error.name },
                ResourceError::MissingHost => Self::MissingHost,
                ResourceError::Missing { name } => Self::Missing { name },
                ResourceError::Read { name, reason } => Self::Read { name, reason },
            }
        }
    }
    
    #[uniffi::export]
    impl NativeCore {
        /// Open a named resource through the reader installed by the application.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// Returns the shared error for an invalid name, absent host, missing file, or failed open.
        pub async fn open_resource(
            &self,
            name: String,
        ) -> Result<Arc<NativeResourceStream>, NativeResourceError> {
            let stream = Resources::from_context(&self.graphics_ctx)
                .open(&name)
                .await?;
            Ok(Arc::new(NativeResourceStream(
                futures_util::lock::Mutex::new(stream),
            )))
        }
    }

        self.reconnectDelay = reconnectDelay

        self.baseURL = baseURL
        self.limit = max(1, maxFrameBytes)
        self.request = request
      }

                else { events.deliver(bytes) }

    class OkHttpChannelFactory(
        private val client: OkHttpClient,
        private val baseUrl: HttpUrl,
        private val maxFrameBytes: Int = 4 * 1024 * 1024,
        private val main: Handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()),
        private val reconnectMillis: Long = 1000,
    ) : ManagedChannelFactory {
        private fun resolve(endpoint: String): HttpUrl = baseUrl.resolve(endpoint.replaceFirst(Regex("^ws"), "http"))
            ?: error("Invalid endpoint")
    
        override fun connectionManager(): ConnectionManager {
            val manager = ConnectionManager { resolve(it).toString() }
            for (kind in listOf(LiveTransport.Sse, LiveTransport.WebSocket, LiveTransport.Http)) {
                manager.register(kind, ConnectionAdapter { endpoint, events ->
                    val url = resolve(endpoint)
                    var active: Channel? = null
                    var stopped = false
                    var retry: Runnable? = null
                    fun connect() {
                        if (stopped) return
                        active = openConnection(url, kind, { events.listening }, { bytes ->
                            if (kind != LiveTransport.WebSocket && SubscriptionFrames.caps(bytes) != null) events.context(bytes)
                            else events.deliver(bytes)
                        }, { error ->
                            if (!stopped) {
                                events.disconnected(error ?: IOException("Live connection closed"))
                                retry = Runnable { connect() }.also { main.postDelayed(it, reconnectMillis) }
                            }
                        }, managed = true, onOpen = events::opened)
                    }
                    connect()
                    object : Channel {
                        override fun close() { stopped = true; retry?.let(main::removeCallbacks); active?.close() }
                        override fun send(bytes: ByteArray) { requireNotNull(active).send(bytes) }
                    }
                })
            }
            return manager
        }

            endpoint: String,
            transport: UByte,
            streamId: ULong,
            resumeFrom: ULong,
            onFrame: (ByteArray) -> Unit,
            onClose: (Throwable?) -> Unit,

            val url = resolve(endpoint).newBuilder()
                .setQueryParameter("stream_id", streamId.toString())
                .setQueryParameter("resume_from", resumeFrom.toString()).build()
            return openConnection(url, transport, { true }, onFrame, onClose, expired = { SubscriptionFrames.expired(streamId,resumeFrom) })
        }

    pub(super) async fn copy(source: &Path, destination: &Path) -> TaskResult {

    pub(super) async fn digest(path: &Path) -> Result<String, TaskError> {
        let path = path.to_owned();
        blocking::unblock(move || digest_file(&path)).await
    }
    
    pub(super) fn digest_file(path: &Path) -> Result<String, TaskError> {
        let mut hash = Sha256::new();
        let mut reader = BufReader::new(File::open(path).map_err(TaskError::operation)?);
        loop {
            let bytes = reader.fill_buf().map_err(TaskError::operation)?;
            if bytes.is_empty() {
                break;
            }
            hash.update(bytes);
            let count = bytes.len();
            reader.consume(count);
        }
        Ok(hex::encode(hash.finalize()))
    }

    @MainActor public struct LocalScreen: View {
      public typealias Loader = @MainActor (NodeStore) async throws -> (any ActionCore, Data)
    
      #if os(iOS)
        @State private var presenter = PresentationAnchor()
      #endif
      private let load: Loader
      @State private var connection: EventBridge?
        private let theme: EweTheme
      @State private var issue: String?
    
      public init(theme: EweTheme = EweTheme(), load: @escaping Loader) {
        self.theme = theme
        self.load = load
      }
    
      public var body: some View {
        Group {
          if let connection {
            EweScreen(store: connection.store, bridge: connection, theme: theme).safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) {
              if let issue { Text(issue) }
            }
          } else if let issue {
            Text(issue)
          } else {
            ProgressView()
          }
        }
        #if os(iOS)
          .background(HostAnchor(anchor: presenter).frame(width: 0, height: 0))
        #endif
        .task {
          guard connection == nil else { return }
          let store = NodeStore()
          #if os(iOS)
            store.commands = presenter.commandHost()
          #endif
          store.onError = { code, message in issue = code + " " + message }
          do {
            let (core, first) = try await load(store)
            try Task.checkCancellation()
            let bridge = EventBridge(store: store, core: core)
            guard store.receive(first) else { throw CocoaError(.fileReadCorruptFile) }
            connection = bridge
          } catch {
            if !Task.isCancelled { issue = error.localizedDescription }
          }
        }
      }
    }

        ///

    use super::{output::artifact, NativeBuildEnv};
    use clap::Args;
    use foundation_tasks::{ProcessCommand, TaskContext, TaskError, TaskResult};
    use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
    
    #[derive(Args)]
    pub(super) struct Generate {
        #[arg(long, required_unless_present = "check")]
        out: Option<PathBuf>,
        #[arg(long)]
        check: bool,
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn run(ctx: TaskContext, args: Generate) -> TaskResult {
        let root = ctx.require::<NativeBuildEnv>()?.root().await?;
        generate(&ctx, &root, args.out.as_deref(), args.check).await
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn generate(
        ctx: &TaskContext,
        root: &Path,
        out: Option<&Path>,
        check: bool,
    ) -> TaskResult {
        let cargo = ProcessCommand::new("cargo").current_dir(root).args([
            "build",
            "--locked",
            "--profile",
            "uat",
            "-p",
            "foundation_ui_native",
            "--features",
            "bindgen",
            "--message-format=json-render-diagnostics",
        ]);
        let shared = artifact(
            ctx,
            cargo.clone().arg("--lib"),
            "foundation_ui_native",
            &[".so", ".dylib", ".dll"],
        )
        .await?;
        let exe = artifact(
            ctx,
            cargo.args(["--bin", "uniffi-bindgen"]),
            "uniffi-bindgen",
            &[],
        )
        .await?;
        let stage = blocking::unblock(tempfile::tempdir)
            .await
            .map_err(TaskError::operation)?;
        let current = stage.path().join("current");
        let out = out.map_or_else(|| stage.path().join("repeated"), |path| root.join(path));
        let targets = if check && out.starts_with(stage.path()) {
            vec![&current, &out]
        } else {
            vec![&current]
        };
        for directory in targets {
            let path = directory.clone();
            blocking::unblock(move || std::fs::create_dir_all(&path))
                .await
                .map_err(TaskError::operation)?;
            for language in ["swift", "kotlin"] {
                ctx.exec(
                    ProcessCommand::new(&exe)
                        .current_dir(root)
                        .arg("generate")
                        .arg("--library")
                        .arg(&shared)
                        .args(["--language", language, "--out-dir"])
                        .arg(directory.join(language))
                        .arg("--no-format"),
                )
                .await?;
            }
        }
        if check {
            for language in ["swift", "kotlin"] {
                ctx.exec(
                    ProcessCommand::new("diff")
                        .current_dir(root)
                        .arg("-ru")
                        .arg(out.join(language))
                        .arg(current.join(language)),
                )
                .await?;
            }
        } else {
            blocking::unblock(move || copy_directory(&current, &out))
                .await
                .map_err(TaskError::operation)?;
        }
        blocking::unblock(move || stage.close())
            .await
            .map_err(TaskError::operation)
    }
    
    fn copy_directory(source: &Path, dest: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dest)?;
        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(source)? {
            let entry = entry?;
            let target = dest.join(entry.file_name());
            if entry.file_type()?.is_dir() {
                copy_directory(&entry.path(), &target)?;
            } else {
                std::fs::copy(entry.path(), target)?;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    #[derive(Args)]
    pub(super) struct BuildAndroid {
        #[arg(long)]
        with_todo: bool,
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn build(ctx: TaskContext, args: BuildAndroid) -> TaskResult {
        let root = ctx.require::<NativeBuildEnv>()?.root().await?;
        build_at(&ctx, &root, args.with_todo).await
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn build_at(ctx: &TaskContext, root: &Path, with_todo: bool) -> TaskResult {
        let environment = read_environment(ctx, root).await?;
        ctx.exec(ProcessCommand::new("mise").current_dir(root).args([
            "exec",
            "--",
            "rustup",
            "target",
            "add",
            "aarch64-linux-android",
            "x86_64-linux-android",
        ]))
        .await?;
        let stage = blocking::unblock(tempfile::tempdir)
            .await
            .map_err(TaskError::operation)?;
        let binding = stage.path().join("binding");
        compile(
            ctx,
            root,
            &binding,
            "foundation_ui_native",
            &[],
            &environment,
        )
        .await?;
        let todo = stage.path().join("todo");
        if with_todo {
            compile(
                ctx,
                root,
                &todo,
                "ui_todo",
                &["--lib", "--no-default-features", "--features", "mobile"],
                &environment,
            )
            .await?;
        }
        let root = root.to_path_buf();
        blocking::unblock(move || {
            install(
                &binding,
                &root.join("mobile/android/binding/src/main/jniLibs"),
                "foundation_ui_native",
            )?;
            if with_todo {
                for app in ["todo_server", "todo_on_device"] {
                    let destination = root
                        .join("examples/ui_todo/android")
                        .join(app)
                        .join("app/src/main/jniLibs");
                    install(&todo, &destination, "ui_todo")?;
                }
            }
            stage.close().map_err(TaskError::operation)
        })
        .await
    }
    
    async fn read_environment(
        ctx: &TaskContext,
        root: &Path,
    ) -> Result<Vec<(OsString, OsString)>, TaskError> {
        let bytes = query(
            ctx,
            ProcessCommand::new("mise")
                .current_dir(root)
                .args(["env", "--json"]),
        )
        .await?;
        let variables: BTreeMap<String, String> =
            serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(TaskError::operation)?;
        let require = |key| {
            variables
                .get(key)
                .cloned()
                .ok_or_else(|| TaskError::operation(format!("mise did not provide {key}")))
        };
        let env = ctx.require::<NativeBuildEnv>()?;
        let home = env.home.clone().ok_or(TaskError::MissingService("HOME"))?;
        let path = require("PATH")?;
        let android = require("ANDROID_HOME")?;
        let ndk = Path::new(&android)
            .join("ndk")
            .join(require("ANDROID_NDK")?);
        let temp = env.temporary_dir.as_os_str().to_owned();
        Ok(vec![
            ("HOME".into(), home),
            ("PATH".into(), path.into()),
            ("TMPDIR".into(), temp),
            ("ANDROID_HOME".into(), android.into()),
            ("ANDROID_NDK_HOME".into(), ndk.into_os_string()),
        ])
    }

        //! Independent WebSocket connections for native host actions.
        use crate::{CoreError, NativeCore};
        use foundation_context::Ctx;
        use std::sync::Arc;
        
        /// One application message preserves its text or binary type.
        #[derive(uniffi::Enum)]
        pub enum SocketMessage {
            Text { value: String },
            Binary { value: Vec<u8> },
        }
        
        /// The host supplies one connection for each successful open.
        #[uniffi::export(with_foreign)]
        #[async_trait::async_trait]
        pub trait HostWebSocket: Send + Sync {
            /// Send one complete application message.
            ///
            /// # Errors
            /// Returns a transport error if the socket cannot accept the message.
            async fn send_message(&self, message: SocketMessage) -> Result<(), CoreError>;
        
            /// Read the next message. A normal peer close returns None.
            ///
            /// # Errors
            /// Returns a transport error if the receive fails.
            async fn receive_message(&self) -> Result<Option<SocketMessage>, CoreError>;
        
            /// Release this connection and wake pending readers. Repeated calls are safe.
            fn close_socket(&self);
        }
        
        /// A host service opens sockets outside the action dispatcher.
        #[uniffi::export(with_foreign)]
        #[async_trait::async_trait]
        pub trait HostWebSockets: Send + Sync {
            /// Open a dedicated connection to the given endpoint.
            ///
            /// # Errors
            /// Returns the connection or handshake error.
            async fn open_socket(&self, endpoint: String) -> Result<Arc<dyn HostWebSocket>, CoreError>;
        }
        
        /// An application owns this socket until it closes or drops the handle.
        #[derive(uniffi::Object)]
        pub struct AppWebSocket(Arc<dyn HostWebSocket>);
        
        impl AppWebSocket {
            /// Open a socket with the service from this host context.
            ///
            /// # Errors
            /// Returns an error for a missing service or a failed connection.
            pub async fn open(ctx: &Ctx, endpoint: String) -> Result<Arc<Self>, CoreError> {
                let service = ctx.get::<Arc<dyn HostWebSockets>>().ok_or_else(|| CoreError::Transport {
                    detail: "The host has no WebSocket service".into(),
                })?;
                Ok(Arc::new(Self(service.open_socket(endpoint).await?)))
            }
        }
        
        #[uniffi::export]
        impl AppWebSocket {
            /// Send one message through this connection.
            ///
            /// # Errors
            /// Returns the host send error.
            pub async fn send(&self, message: SocketMessage) -> Result<(), CoreError> {
                self.0.send_message(message).await
            }
        
            /// Receive one message or the end of the connection.
            ///
            /// # Errors
            /// Returns the host receive error.
            pub async fn receive(&self) -> Result<Option<SocketMessage>, CoreError> {
                self.0.receive_message().await
            }
        
            /// Close this connection.
            pub fn close_socket(&self) {
                self.0.close_socket();
            }
        }
        
        impl Drop for AppWebSocket {
            fn drop(&mut self) {
                self.close_socket();
            }
        }
        
        #[uniffi::export]
        impl NativeCore {
            /// Install the platform service before the first action.
            pub fn install_web_sockets(&self, service: Arc<dyn HostWebSockets>) {
                self.graphics_ctx.store(service);
            }
        
            /// Open an application connection from the core context.
            ///
            /// # Errors
            /// Returns the service lookup or connection error.
            pub async fn open_web_socket(&self, endpoint: String) -> Result<Arc<AppWebSocket>, CoreError> {
                AppWebSocket::open(&self.graphics_ctx, endpoint).await
            }
        }
        RS

    final class ResourceTests: XCTestCase {
        func testInstalledBundleReader() async throws {
            let environment = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
            try XCTSkipUnless(environment["EWE_RESOURCE_TEST_BUNDLE"] != nil,
                              "Run the installed package check with the application bundle path and expected hash")
            let path = try XCTUnwrap(environment["EWE_RESOURCE_TEST_BUNDLE"], "Pass the path of the installed TodoServer bundle")
            let bundle = try XCTUnwrap(Bundle(path: path))
            let core = try createLocalTodoCore(platform: .ios)
            do {
                _ = try await core.openResource(name: "art/todo.svg")
                XCTFail("Expected a missing host")
            } catch NativeResourceError.MissingHost { }
            core.installResources(source: BundleResourceSource(bundle: bundle))
            let file = try await core.openResource(name: "art/todo.svg")
            var hash = SHA256()
            while let bytes = try await file.nextChunk() {
                hash.update(data: bytes)
            }
            XCTAssertEqual(hash.finalize().map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined(),
                           try XCTUnwrap(environment["EWE_RESOURCE_TEST_HASH"]))
            do {
                _ = try await core.openResource(name: "app.js")
                XCTFail("Unexpected browser-only file")
            } catch NativeResourceError.Missing(let name) { XCTAssertEqual(name, "app.js") }
            do {
                _ = try await core.openResource(name: "../outside")
                XCTFail("Expected an invalid resource name")
            } catch NativeResourceError.InvalidName { }
        }
    }

    internal suspend fun verifyInstalledResources(assets: AssetManager, expectedHash: String) {
        System.setProperty("uniffi.component.foundation_ui_native.libraryOverride", "ui_todo")
        createLocalTodoCore(NativePlatform.ANDROID).use { core ->
            try {
                core.openResource("art/todo.svg")
                error("Expected a missing host")
            } catch (_: NativeResourceException.MissingHost) {}
            core.installResources(AndroidResourceSource(assets))
            val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            core.openResource("art/todo.svg").use { file ->
                while (true) digest.update(file.nextChunk() ?: break)
            }
            check(digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) } == expectedHash)
            try {
                core.openResource("app.js")
                error("Unexpected browser-only file")
            } catch (_: NativeResourceException.Missing) {}
            try {
                core.openResource("../outside")
                error("Expected an invalid name")
            } catch (_: NativeResourceException.InvalidName) {}
        }
    }

    pub(super) async fn ios(ctx: TaskContext, args: Check) -> TaskResult {
        let root = ctx.require::<NativeBuildEnv>()?.root().await?;
        let wire = root.join("backends/foundation_ui_wire");
        let package = root.join("mobile/ios");
        let stage = blocking::unblock(tempfile::tempdir)
            .await
            .map_err(TaskError::operation)?;
        let generated = stage.path().join("bindings");
        bindings::generate(&ctx, &root, Some(&generated), false).await?;
        let source = wire.join("fixtures");
        let dest = stage.path().to_path_buf();
        let gpu = root.join("backends/foundation_ui_gpu/tests/shaders");
        let core = generated.join("swift/EweCore.swift");
        blocking::unblock(move || {
            copy(&[core], &dest.join("EweCore"))?;
            let fixtures = dest.join("Fixtures");
            let native = std::fs::read_dir(source.join("native"))?
                .map(|entry| entry.map(|entry| entry.path()))
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
            copy(&native, &fixtures)?;
            copy(
                &named(
                    &source,
                    &[
                        "frame_ops_all_forms.bin",
                        "frame_state_custom.bin",
                        "state_counter_custom.json",
                        "action_increment_custom.bin",
                    ],
                ),
                &fixtures,
            )?;
            if gpu.is_dir() {
                let shaders = std::fs::read_dir(gpu)?
                    .filter_map(|entry| match entry {
                        Ok(entry) if entry.path().extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "wgsl") => {
                            Some(Ok(entry.path()))
                        }
                        Ok(_) => None,
                        Err(error) => Some(Err(error)),
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
                copy(&shaders, &fixtures)?;
            }
            Ok::<_, std::io::Error>(())
        })
        .await
        .map_err(TaskError::operation)?;
        for (from, into) in [
            (
                wire.join("generated/swift"),
                package.join("Sources/EweWire"),

            (
                stage.path().join("EweCore"),
                package.join("Sources/EweCore"),
            ),
            (
                stage.path().join("Fixtures"),
                package.join("Tests/EweUITests/Fixtures"),
            ),
        ] {
            sync(&ctx, &root, &from, &into, args.check).await?;
        }
        blocking::unblock(move || stage.close())
            .await
            .map_err(TaskError::operation)
    }

    async fn stage_package(

        framework: &Path,
    ) -> TaskResult {

        }
        let (root, output, stage, generated, bridge, framework) = (
            root.to_path_buf(),

            let packages = output.join(".build-inputs");
            std::fs::create_dir_all(&packages)?;
            replace_framework(&framework, &packages.join("EweCoreFFI.xcframework"), &stage.join("previous.xcframework"))
        }).await.map_err(TaskError::operation)
    }

        #if os(iOS) || os(macOS)
        import EweCore
        import Foundation
        
        /// Opens independent application sockets with the supplied network session.
        public final class AppWebSockets: HostWebSockets {
          private let session: URLSession
          public init(session: URLSession = .shared) { self.session = session }
        
          public func openSocket(endpoint: String) async throws -> AppWebSocket {
            guard let url = URL(string: endpoint), let scheme = url.scheme?.lowercased(),
                  ["ws", "wss"].contains(scheme), url.host != nil else {
              throw CoreError.Transport(detail: "Invalid WebSocket endpoint")
            }
            let task = session.webSocketTask(with: url)
            let opened = AsyncThrowingStream<Void, Error>.makeStream()
            let delegate = SocketHandshake(opened.continuation)
            task.delegate = delegate
            task.resume()
            do {
              var events = opened.stream.makeAsyncIterator()
              guard try await events.next() != nil else { throw URLError(.networkConnectionLost) }
              try Task.checkCancellation()
              return AppWebSocket(socket: SessionSocket(task))
            } catch {
              task.cancel()
              throw CoreError.Transport(detail: error.localizedDescription)
            }
          }
        }
        
        private final class SocketHandshake: NSObject, URLSessionWebSocketDelegate {
          let result: AsyncThrowingStream<Void, Error>.Continuation
          init(_ result: AsyncThrowingStream<Void, Error>.Continuation) { self.result = result }
        
          func urlSession(_ session: URLSession, webSocketTask: URLSessionWebSocketTask, didOpenWithProtocol name: String?) {
            result.yield(())
            result.finish()
          }
          func urlSession(_ session: URLSession, task: URLSessionTask, didCompleteWithError error: Error?) {
            result.finish(throwing: error ?? URLError(.networkConnectionLost))
          }
          func urlSession(_ session: URLSession, webSocketTask: URLSessionWebSocketTask,
                          didCloseWith closeCode: URLSessionWebSocketTask.CloseCode, reason: Data?) {
            result.finish()
          }
        }
        
        private final class SessionSocket: HostWebSocket {
          let task: URLSessionWebSocketTask
          init(_ task: URLSessionWebSocketTask) { self.task = task }
        
          func sendMessage(message: SocketMessage) async throws {
            do {
              switch message {
              case .text(let value): try await task.send(.string(value))
              case .binary(let value): try await task.send(.data(value))
              }
            } catch { throw CoreError.Transport(detail: error.localizedDescription) }
          }
        
          func receiveMessage() async throws -> SocketMessage? {
            do {
              switch try await task.receive() {
              case .string(let value): return .text(value: value)
              case .data(let value): return .binary(value: value)
              @unknown default: throw URLError(.cannotDecodeContentData)
              }
            } catch {
              if task.closeCode == .normalClosure { return nil }
              throw CoreError.Transport(detail: error.localizedDescription)
            }
          }
        
          func closeSocket() { task.cancel(with: .normalClosure, reason: nil) }
        }
        #endif

        package ewe.ui.android
        
        import io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.AppWebSocket
        import io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.CoreException
        import io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.HostWebSocket
        import io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.HostWebSockets
        import io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.SocketMessage
        import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
        import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
        import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
        import okhttp3.Request
        import okhttp3.Response
        import okhttp3.WebSocket
        import okhttp3.WebSocketListener
        import okio.ByteString
        import okio.ByteString.Companion.toByteString
        
        /** Opens independent application sockets with the supplied network client. */
        class AppWebSockets(
            private val client: OkHttpClient = OkHttpClient(),
            private val queueCapacity: Int = Channel.BUFFERED,
        ) : HostWebSockets {
            override suspend fun openSocket(endpoint: String): AppWebSocket {
                if (!endpoint.startsWith("ws://", true) && !endpoint.startsWith("wss://", true)) {
                    throw CoreException.Transport("Invalid WebSocket endpoint")
                }
                val request = try {
                    Request.Builder().url(endpoint).build()
                } catch (error: IllegalArgumentException) {
                    throw CoreException.Transport(error.message.orEmpty())
                }
                val listener = ApplicationListener(queueCapacity)
                val socket = client.newWebSocket(request, listener)
                try {
                    listener.opened.await()
                    return AppWebSocket(object : HostWebSocket {
                        override suspend fun sendMessage(message: SocketMessage) {
                            val accepted = when (message) {
                                is SocketMessage.Text -> socket.send(message.value)
                                is SocketMessage.Binary -> socket.send(message.value.toByteString())
                            }
                            if (!accepted) throw CoreException.Transport("The socket rejected the message")
                        }
        
                        override suspend fun receiveMessage(): SocketMessage? {
                            val result = listener.messages.receiveCatching()
                            result.exceptionOrNull()?.let { throw it }
                            return result.getOrNull()
                        }
        
                        override fun closeSocket() {
                            listener.messages.close()
                            socket.close(1000, null)
                        }
                    })
                } catch (error: Throwable) {
                    socket.cancel()
                    throw error
                }
            }
        }
        
        private class ApplicationListener(capacity: Int) : WebSocketListener() {
            val opened = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
            val messages = Channel<SocketMessage>(capacity)
            override fun onOpen(webSocket: WebSocket, response: Response) { opened.complete(Unit) }
            override fun onMessage(webSocket: WebSocket, text: String) = deliver(webSocket, SocketMessage.Text(text))
            override fun onMessage(webSocket: WebSocket, bytes: ByteString) = deliver(webSocket, SocketMessage.Binary(bytes.toByteArray()))
        
            private fun deliver(socket: WebSocket, message: SocketMessage) {
                val result = messages.trySend(message)
                if (result.isFailure && !result.isClosed) {
                    messages.close(CoreException.Transport("The socket receive queue is full"))
                    socket.cancel()
                }
            }
        
            override fun onClosing(webSocket: WebSocket, code: Int, reason: String) {
                webSocket.close(1000, null)
                messages.close(if (code == 1000) null else CoreException.Transport("Peer closed the socket: $code $reason"))
            }
        
            override fun onFailure(webSocket: WebSocket, t: Throwable, response: Response?) {
                val failure = CoreException.Transport(t.message ?: t.toString())
                opened.completeExceptionally(failure)
                messages.close(failure)
            }
        }

                            val todo = io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.todo.getTodo(client, base, id)
                            check(todo.id == id && todo.title == "Buy milk")
                            try {
                                io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.todo.getTodo(client, base, "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000999")
                                error("Expected NotFound")
                            } catch (_: io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.todo.TodoServiceException.NotFound) { }
                            try {
                                io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.todo.getTodo(client, base, "42")

                            } catch (error: io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.todo.TodoServiceException.Failed) {
                                check(error.detail.contains("UUID"))
                            }
                        }
                        results.putString("stream", "GetTodo returned the requested UUID, Buy milk, and NotFound.")
                        return@runBlocking
                    }
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        val client = OkHttpClient()
                        val endpoint = base.toHttpUrl()
                        val connection = HttpActionConnection(client, endpoint)
                        val store = NodeStore(GapTimer { _, _ -> Cancel {} })
                        val native =
                            NativeCore.remote(
                                NativePlatform.ANDROID,
                                listOf("add_todo", "confirm_delete"),
                                connection,
                            )
                        LiveMountHost(store, OkHttpChannelFactory(client, endpoint)).use {
                            CoreBinding(native, store, this).use { core ->
                                check(store.receive(connection.negotiate(core)))
                                check(store.receive(connection.initial("initial")))
                                check(store.nodes.any { it.text == "Android server todo" }) {
                                    "The second client did not receive the server app's todo"
                                }
                                val title = "Android replay verification"
                                val add = EventInput(1u, "submit", title, false, 0u, byteArrayOf())
                                check(store.receive(requireNotNull(core.trigger("server:add_todo", add))))
                                val label = withTimeout(5000) {
                                    var updated = store.nodes.lastOrNull { it.text == title }
                                    while (updated == null) {
                                        delay(50)
                                        updated = store.nodes.lastOrNull { it.text == title }
                                    }
                                    updated
                                }
                                var row = label
                                while (
                                    row.children.none {
                                        store.record(it)?.actions?.get(EventId.TAP) == "server:toggle_todo"
                                    }
                                ) {
                                    row = store.record(requireNotNull(row.parent))!!
                                }
                                val toggle =
                                    row.children.mapNotNull(store::record).first {
                                        it.actions[EventId.TAP] == "server:toggle_todo"
                                    }
                                val id = toggle.props.getValue(PropId.VALUE).label
                                val event = EventInput(toggle.id, "tap", id, false, row.id, byteArrayOf())
                                var failure: String? = null
                                store.onError = { code, message -> failure = "$code $message" }
                                check(
                                    store.receive(requireNotNull(core.trigger("server:confirm_delete", event)))
                                )
                                check(failure == null) { "First deletion failed: $failure" }
                                withTimeout(5000) {
                                    while (store.nodes.any { it.text == title }) delay(50)
                                }
                                check(
                                    store.receive(requireNotNull(core.trigger("server:confirm_delete", event)))
                                )
                                check(failure != null) { "Repeated delete was accepted" }
                                results.putString("stream", "Second client received the todo. Second delete refused: $failure")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                finish(Activity.RESULT_OK, results)
            } catch (error: Throwable) {
                results.putString("stream", error.stackTraceToString())
                finish(Activity.RESULT_CANCELED, results)
            }

    final class TodoTests: XCTestCase {
      @MainActor func testSubscriptionReplayUsesTheOpenDelivery() async throws {
        let address = try XCTUnwrap(ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EWE_TODO_URL"])
        let base = try XCTUnwrap(URL(string: address))
        let manager = URLSessionChannelFactory(baseURL: base).connectionManager()
        defer { manager.close() }
        for transport in ["sse", "http", "websocket"] {
          let socket = transport == "websocket"
          let url = try XCTUnwrap(URL(string: socket ? "/socket" : "/live", relativeTo: base))
          let id = try manager.nextTag()
          let greeting = expectation(description: "\(transport) handshake")
          let expired = expectation(description: "\(transport) targeted expiry")
          var session: UInt64?
          func context(_ bytes: Data) {
            guard session == nil, let caps = SubscriptionFrames.caps(bytes), caps.subscriptionResume else { return }
            session = caps.streamId
            greeting.fulfill()
          }
          let handle = try manager.acquire(transport, endpoint: url, shared: true,
            onContext: context, onError: { XCTFail($0) }, receive: { bytes in
              if SubscriptionFrames.caps(bytes) != nil { context(bytes); return }
              var buffer = ByteBuffer(data: bytes)
              guard let frame: ewe_ui_Frame = try? getCheckedRoot(byteBuffer: &buffer, fileId: "EWF1"),
                let body = frame.kind(type: ewe_ui_FrameMessage.self), body.subscriptionId == id,
                body.messages(at: 0)?.control?.replayExpired?.streamId == 1 else { return }
              expired.fulfill()
            })
          defer { handle.close() }
          if socket { try await handle.send(SubscriptionFrames.hello(id)) }
          await fulfillment(of: [greeting], timeout: 10)
          try await handle.send(SubscriptionFrames.resume(session: try XCTUnwrap(session), id: id, stream: 1, after: UInt64.max))
          await fulfillment(of: [expired], timeout: 10)
        }
      }
    
      func testCountPublishedToOpenMobileAndWebViews() throws {
        let env = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
        guard let before = env["EWE_SHARED_COUNT_BEFORE"], let after = env["EWE_SHARED_COUNT_AFTER"] else {
          throw XCTSkip("This check runs with a browser and another native peer")
        }
        let app = XCUIApplication()
        app.launchEnvironment["EWE_TODO_URL"] = try XCTUnwrap(env["EWE_TODO_URL"])
        app.launch()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts[before].waitForExistence(timeout: 20))
        print("iPhone subscribed at \(before)")
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts[after].waitForExistence(timeout: 90))
      }
    
      func testOrdinaryDataService() async throws {
        let base = try XCTUnwrap(ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EWE_DATA_URL"])
        let client = NativeHttpClient(client: URLSessionRpcClient())
        let id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000042"
        let todo = try await getTodo(client: client, baseUrl: base, id: id)
        XCTAssertEqual(todo.id, id)
        XCTAssertEqual(todo.title, "Buy milk")
        do {
          _ = try await getTodo(client: client, baseUrl: base, id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000999")
          XCTFail("Expected the service to return NotFound")
        } catch TodoServiceError.NotFound { }
        do {
          _ = try await getTodo(client: client, baseUrl: base, id: "42")
          XCTFail("Expected the client to reject a numeric identifier")
        } catch TodoServiceError.Failed(let detail) {
          XCTAssertTrue(detail.contains("UUID"))
        }
      }

    import ewe.ui.*
    import ewe.ui.runtime.ConnectionManager
    import io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.HostTransport
    import java.io.IOException

    import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
