    #[action(server)]
    async fn add_todo(ctx: &Context, event: Interaction<(), AddInput>) -> ActionResult {
        let input = event.input_value;
        let title = input.title.trim();
        if title.is_empty() {
            return Err(ErrorTrace::new(ActionError::new(
                ErrorCode::InvalidInput,
                "Enter a todo title",
            )));
        }
        let store = todo_store(ctx)?;
        let mut state = store
            .0
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
        if let Some(receipt) = state.creations.get(&input.id) {
            if receipt.submitted_title != input.title {
                return Err(ErrorTrace::new(ActionError::new(
                    ErrorCode::InvalidInput,
                    "The creation identifier already belongs to a different submission",
                )));
            }
            let (position, change) = match state.removed.get(&receipt.item.id) {
                Some(position) => {
                    TodoDelivery::Retired { id: input.id }.send(ctx)?;
                    (*position, RecordChange::Remove(receipt.item.id))
                }
                None => (receipt.position, RecordChange::Upsert(receipt.item.clone())),
            };
            return TodoDelivery::Committed { position, change }.send(ctx);
        }
        let item = Todo {
            id: input.id,
            text: title.to_owned(),
            done: false,
        };
        let delivery = commit(ctx, &mut state, RecordChange::Upsert(item.clone()))?;
        let position = state.position;
        state.creations.insert(
            input.id,
            CreationReceipt {
                item,
                position,
                submitted_title: input.title,
            },
        );
        delivery.send(ctx)?;
        Ok(())
    }
    
    #[action(server)]
    async fn toggle_todo(ctx: &Context, event: Interaction<()>) -> ActionResult {
        let id = todo_id(&event.input_value)?;
        mutate(ctx, |state| {
            let mut item = state
                .items
                .iter()
                .find(|row| row.id == id)
                .cloned()
                .ok_or_else(|| error("Todo does not exist"))?;
            item.done = !item.done;
            Ok(RecordChange::Upsert(item))
        })
    }
    
    #[action(server)]
    async fn confirm_delete(ctx: &Context, event: Interaction<()>) -> ActionResult {
        let id = todo_id(&event.input_value)?;
        mutate(ctx, |state| {
            if !state.removed.contains_key(&id) && !state.items.iter().any(|row| row.id == id) {
                return Err(error("Todo does not exist"));
            }
            Ok(RecordChange::Remove(id))
        })?;
        TodoDelivery::Deleted { id }.send(ctx)
    }

    impl From<String> for RawInput {
        fn from(value: String) -> Self {
            Self::Text(value)
        }
    }
    
    impl From<&str> for RawInput {
        fn from(value: &str) -> Self {
            Self::Text(value.to_owned())
        }
    }
    
    impl RawInput {
        /// Decode text or structured input using the default action contract.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// Rejects a mismatched encoding or invalid input.
        pub fn decode<E: DeserializeOwned + 'static>(self) -> Result<E, ErrorTrace<ActionError>> {
            let invalid = |message| ErrorTrace::new(ActionError::new(ErrorCode::InvalidInput, message));
            if TypeId::of::<E>() == TypeId::of::<String>() {
                let text = match self {
                    Self::Missing => String::new(),
                    Self::Text(value) => value,
                    Self::Json(_) => return Err(invalid("The action requires text input")),
                };
                let value = serde::de::value::StringDeserializer::<serde::de::value::Error>::new(text);
                return E::deserialize(value).map_err(|e| invalid("Invalid text input").attach(e));
            }
            match self {
                Self::Json(bytes) => serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)
                    .map_err(|error| invalid("Invalid structured action input").attach(error)),
                _ => Err(invalid("The action requires structured input")),
            }
        }
    }

        fn requires_state(&self) -> bool;
        fn call_raw<'a>(&'a self, ctx: &'a Context, event: RawInteraction) -> ActionFuture<'a>;
    }

        }

    fn creation_retries_match_the_original_payload_and_respect_deletion() {
        let ctx = Ctx::host();
        ctx.store(TodoStore::default());
        let registry = server_registry().unwrap();
        let call = |name: &str, input: ActionInputT| {
            let mut request = ActionRequestT::default();
            request.input = Some(Box::new(input));
            let action = registry
                .get(Origin::Server, name, MountSurface::Web)
                .unwrap();
            futures_lite::future::block_on(invoke_action(
                &ctx,
                action,
                MountSurface::Web,
                None,
                request,
            ))
        };
        let add = |key: &str, title: &str| {
            let mut input = ActionInputT::default();
            input.json =
                Some(serde_json::to_vec(&serde_json::json!({"id": key, "title": title})).unwrap());
            call("add_todo", input)
        };
        let first = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
        let second = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002";
        assert!(add("bad key", "same").is_err());

        let mut without_id = ActionInputT::default();

        assert!(call("add_todo", without_id).is_err());

    //! Build the two classic scripts used by the browser host.
    use std::prelude::rust_2021::*;
    use std::{
        fs, io,
        path::{Path, PathBuf},
    };
    
    pub const READABLE: &str = "foundation-ui-runtime.js";
    pub const MINIFIED: &str = "foundation-ui-runtime.min.js";
    
    /// Generate the browser scripts or compare them with the destination files.
    pub fn generate(runtime: &Path, output: &Path, check: bool) -> io::Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {
        let bundle = foundation_codegen::javascript::bundle(&runtime.join("runtime-entry.js"))
            .map_err(|e| io::Error::other(format!("{e:#}")))?;
        if !check {
            fs::create_dir_all(output)?;
        }
        for (name, contents) in [(READABLE, bundle.readable), (MINIFIED, bundle.minified)] {
            let target = output.join(name);
            match fs::read(&target) {
                Ok(existing) if existing == contents => {}
                Err(e) if e.kind() != io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Err(e),
                _ if check => {
                    return Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                        "Generated file differs: {}",
                        target.display()
                    )));
                }
                _ => fs::write(&target, contents)?,
            }
        }
        Ok(bundle.inputs)
    }

    // Import the WebAssembly runtime before installing the browser user interface.
    import "../../foundation_wasm/runtime/foundation-wasm.js";
    import "./foundation-ui-bootstrap.js";
    import "./platform-scheme-interceptor.js";
    //! WHY: The crate that defines the UI runtime owns how it ships (feature 20)
    //! — including a standalone CLI, so `cargo install foundation_wasm_ui` is all
    //! a consumer needs.
    //!
    //! WHAT: `ewe-wasm-bundle` — the `foundation_wasm_ui::cli` surface
    //! (`build`, `plan`) as its own binary.
    
    #[cfg(not(target_family = "wasm"))]
    fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
        #[cfg(feature = "tasks")]
        if std::env::args_os().nth(1).as_deref() == Some(std::ffi::OsStr::new("task")) {
            return foundation_tasks::run_entry("ewe-wasm-bundle", |mut runner| {
                Box::pin(async move {
                    runner.register(foundation_wasm_ui::tasks::set()?)?;
                    runner.run().await
                })
            });
        }
        tracing_subscriber::fmt().with_target(false).init();
        let matches = foundation_wasm_ui::cli::command().get_matches();
        if let Err(error) = foundation_wasm_ui::cli::run(&matches) {
            tracing::error!("ewe-wasm-bundle: {error}");
            return std::process::ExitCode::FAILURE;
        }
        std::process::ExitCode::SUCCESS
    }
    
    // Cargo builds every target on `--target wasm32-*` too; the CLI is native
    // tooling, so the wasm build degrades to a stub.
    #[cfg(target_family = "wasm")]
    fn main() {}

    async fn submit(ctx: &Context, key: String, proposed: Option<PendingChange>) -> ActionResult {
        let selected = change_pending(ctx, |entries| {
            if let Some(entry) = entries.get_mut(&key) {
                if !entry.retry {
                    return Ok((false, None));
                }
                entry.retry = false;
                return Ok((true, Some(entry.change.clone())));
            }
            let change = proposed.ok_or_else(|| error("The pending change has already finished"))?;
            if let PendingChange::Add { .. } = change {
                let correction = todo_store(ctx)?
                    .0
                    .lock()
                    .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner)
                    .correcting
                    .clone();
                if let Some(previous) = correction {
                    entries.remove(&previous);
                }
            }
            entries.insert(
                key.clone(),
                Pending {
                    change: change.clone(),
                    retry: false,
                    validation: None,
                },
            );
            Ok((true, Some(change)))
        })
        .await?;
        let Some(selected) = selected else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        {
            let store = todo_store(ctx)?;
            let mut state = store
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
            state.correcting = None;
            state.add_dialog = false;
            state.delete_target = None;
            state.draft.clear();
            dialog(ctx, &state.snapshot())?;
            state.render_rows(ctx)?;
        }
        let result = match selected {
            PendingChange::Add { id, title } => {
                ctx.trigger_structured("server:add_todo", &AddInput { id, title })
                    .await
            }
            PendingChange::Delete { id } => ctx.trigger_structured("server:confirm_delete", &id).await,
        };
        if let Err(cause) = result {
            let detail = cause.current_context();
            let validation = (detail.code == ErrorCode::InvalidInput).then(|| detail.message.clone());
            failed(ctx, &key, validation).await?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    pub(crate) async fn failed(ctx: &Context, key: &str, validation: Option<String>) -> ActionResult {
        let changed = change_pending(ctx, |entries| {
            let Some(entry) = entries.get_mut(key) else {
                return Ok((false, false));
            };
            entry.retry = true;
            if validation.is_some() && matches!(entry.change, PendingChange::Add { .. }) {
                entry.validation = validation;
            }
            Ok((true, true))
        })
        .await?;
        if changed {
            let store = todo_store(ctx)?;
            let state = store
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
            state.render_rows(ctx)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    pub(super) struct Reconciled {
        pub(super) changed: bool,
        pub(super) added: bool,
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn reconcile(
        ctx: &Context,
        snapshot: bool,
    ) -> Result<Reconciled, ErrorTrace<ActionError>> {
        let store = todo_store(ctx)?;
        let (result, deleted) = change_pending(ctx, |entries| {
            let state = store
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
            let before = entries.len();
            let mut added = false;
            let mut deleted = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
            entries.retain(|_, pending| {
                let accepted = confirmed(&state, &pending.change, snapshot);
                if let PendingChange::Delete { id } = pending.change {
                    if accepted {
                        deleted.insert(id);
                    }
                }
                if let PendingChange::Add { id, .. } = pending.change {
                    added |= accepted && !state.retired_ids.contains(&id);
                }
                !accepted
            });
            let changed = entries.len() != before;
            Ok((changed, (Reconciled { changed, added }, deleted)))
        })
        .await?;
        if !deleted.is_empty() {
            let mut state = store
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
            if let Some(rows) = &mut state.search_rows {
                rows.retain(|row| !deleted.contains(&row.id));
            }
        }
        Ok(result)
    }
    
    fn confirmed(state: &StoreState, change: &PendingChange, snapshot: bool) -> bool {
        match change {
            PendingChange::Add { id, .. } => {
                state.retired_ids.contains(id) || state.items.iter().any(|row| row.id == *id)
            }
            PendingChange::Delete { id } => {
                state.removed.contains_key(id)
                    || (snapshot && !state.items.iter().any(|row| row.id == *id))
            }
        }
    }

    ## Critical Reminders
    
    1. **Retrieval-Led Reasoning**: Read codebase FIRST, follow discovered patterns, verify assumptions
    2. **Agent Documentation**: Each agent reads their own documentation file which specifies skills to load
    3. **Skills-Based**: Load only required skills, not everything
    4. **Main Agent**: Orchestrator only - delegates ALL work
    5. **Verification Required**: NO commits without verification passing
    6. **Incomplete Implementation Check**: MANDATORY first check in verification
    7. **Sub-agents**: Never commit directly, never spawn verification agents
    8. **Context Optimization**: Load ONLY what you need
    9. **I/O & Async (Rust)**: Stream bodies, never buffer them (status first); use generated API types and fix the generator rather than working around it; async `fn`s all the way down, with valtron composing via futures/future streams under its existing Send/!Send/boundary rules — see `skills/rust-clean-code/implementation` §6–8
    10. **Executors must run the tests**: a green `cargo check`/`cargo clippy` is not a pass. An executor runs `cargo test -p <crate> --profile uat` and reports the output before it calls the work done.
    11. **Linux compatibility check**: after you commit a crate, spawn one agent to run `scripts/ci/linux.sh <crate>` in the Linux CI Docker image, to compile and run its tests on Linux.
    12. **Version bump on new public API**: when a crate gains a new public API (a new module, function, type, or trait method), bump its version and move every workspace consumer's `version` requirement to match in the same change. Do not defer it to release time: a `path`+`version` dependency resolves to the published crate on `cargo package`, so a deferred bump lets a packaged consumer pick the stale registry version without the new API.
    13. **Agent work vs your uncommitted changes**: if an agent's edits will not break your uncommitted work, spawn it in the same tree and verify after it reports. If they can conflict, commit your work first, then give the agent a worktree; it pushes to a new branch, you merge back, and it deletes the worktree.
    14. **Time types come from `foundation_compact`**: use `foundation_compact::Instant` for a monotonic instant and `foundation_compact::SystemTime` for a wall-clock time. Never use `std::time::Instant` or `std::time::SystemTime` for a value that comes from `Clock`. On native targets the two names are the same type. On `wasm32-unknown-unknown` they are different types and the `std` clock reads panic, so a mixed pair fails the wasm gate and only the wasm gate. Name the type in full. Do not import it under a stand-in name such as `ReadinessInstant as Instant`. A crate without a direct `foundation_compact` dependency adds one (`default-features = false`).
    15. **The strongest model plans; smaller models do the work** (owner rule 2026-11-11): the main agent runs on the most powerful model (for example Opus). It plans and writes the specifications, feature documents and detailed task briefs. Sonnet or Haiku sub-agents do the work from those briefs: Sonnet for implementation, multi-file fixes, tests and CI reproduction; Haiku for mechanical edits, search, log reading and lint fixes. Pick the model that gives correct, verified work for the lowest token use. See `skills/main-agent-orchestration/skill.md`, "Delegate for Cost".
    16. **Platform code is tested on its platform** (owner rule 2026-11-11): every crate runs its tests on Linux, macOS and Windows in CI. A `cargo check` or a cross-compile is not a test. A crate that cannot run its tests on one OS opts out in `ci/packages.toml` (`macos-tests = "none"` or `windows-tests = "none"`) with a reason that names the missing tool or service. A crate that fails on an OS because of a known bug may also opt out, with a reason that names the open GitHub issue; the fix of that issue removes the opt-out.
    17. **CI fits the free tier: jobs queue, they do not stampede** (owner rule 2026-11-11): matrix jobs set `max-parallel` from configuration; each workflow has a concurrency group that cancels superseded pull request runs and queues master runs; a pull request runs only the packages its change affects (the CI runner checks this too); a normal pull request runs Linux only; macOS and Windows run on master, on `platform/release` (pushes and pull requests into or from it), the nightly schedule and manual runs; CI uses the free GitHub-hosted runners (a public repository), not paid runners. Avoid pushes that only restart CI: batch fixes into one push.
    18. **Latest versions, one version per dependency** (owner rule 2026-11-11): use the latest stable version of every dependency. A dependency that more than one crate uses is declared once in the root `[workspace.dependencies]`, and each crate uses `{ workspace = true }`. `Cargo.lock` holds one version of it. A second version is allowed only when an upstream crate forces it, with the reason in a comment. A pre-release is not "latest stable".
    19. **Write in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (STE)**: every response, specification, document, code comment, commit message and pull request uses STE. Use at most 20 words in a step sentence and 25 words in a description sentence. Use the active voice and the simple present tense. Give one idea in each sentence. Spell out each abbreviation at its first use in each document. The `UserPromptSubmit` hook in `.claude/settings.json` adds this rule to every message.

    //! Connect each Rust child call to its browser view.
    extern crate std;
    use super::{take_request, BTreeMap, RefCell, Vec};
    use alloc::boxed::Box;
    use alloc::string::{String, ToString};
    use core::cell::Cell;
    use foundation_ui_runtime::action::{ActionError, ChildActionCaller};
    use foundation_ui_wire::{
        writer::{write_messages, ClientCaps, FrameHeader, WriterConfig},
        ErrorCode, MessageT,
    };
    
    pub(super) struct BrowserCaller(pub u64);
    type Reply = Result<(), ActionError>;
    
    std::thread_local! {
        static NEXT: Cell<u64> = const { Cell::new(0) };
        static WAITING: RefCell<BTreeMap<u64, async_channel::Sender<Reply>>> = const { RefCell::new(BTreeMap::new()) };
    }
    
    struct Pending(u64);
    impl Drop for Pending {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            WAITING.with_borrow_mut(|calls| calls.remove(&self.0));
        }
    }
    
    fn failure(message: impl Into<String>) -> ActionError {
        ActionError::new(ErrorCode::ActionFailed, message)
    }
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait(?Send)]
    impl ChildActionCaller for BrowserCaller {
        async fn call(&self, reference: &str, json: Vec<u8>, preview: Vec<MessageT>) -> Reply {
            let bytes = if preview.is_empty() {
                Vec::new()
            } else {
                let header = FrameHeader {
                    stream_id: 0,
                    sequence_id: 0,
                    ack: 0,
                };
                write_messages(
                    preview,
                    &ClientCaps::web_current(),
                    header,
                    &WriterConfig::default(),
                )
                .map_err(|error| failure(error.to_string()))?
                .0
            };
            let id = NEXT
                .with(|next| {
                    let id = next.get().checked_add(1)?;
                    next.set(id);
                    Some(id)
                })
                .ok_or_else(|| failure("Child request identifiers exhausted"))?;
            let (send, receive) = async_channel::bounded(1);
            WAITING.with_borrow_mut(|calls| calls.insert(id, send));
            let _pending = Pending(id);
            #[link(wasm_import_module = "env")]
            extern "C" {
                fn ewe_ui_child(
                    parent: u64,
                    id: u64,
                    name: *const u8,
                    name_len: usize,
                    json: *const u8,
                    json_len: usize,
                    preview: *const u8,
                    preview_len: usize,
                );
            }
            // The browser copies all three slices before the import returns.
            unsafe {
                ewe_ui_child(
                    self.0,
                    id,
                    reference.as_ptr(),
                    reference.len(),
                    json.as_ptr(),
                    json.len(),
                    bytes.as_ptr(),
                    bytes.len(),
                )
            };
            receive
                .recv()
                .await
                .map_err(|_| failure("The browser action service closed"))?
        }
    }
    
    /// Complete one child call. Consume the error slot even when the caller has closed.
    #[no_mangle]
    pub extern "C" fn ewe_ui_child_done(id: u64, code: i32, slot: u64) {
        let result = if code < 0 {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            let message = take_request(slot)
                .and_then(|bytes| String::from_utf8(bytes).ok())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Browser action failed".into());
            Err(ActionError::new(
                ErrorCode(u16::try_from(code).unwrap_or(ErrorCode::ActionFailed.0)),
                message,
            ))
        };
        if let Some(sender) = WAITING.with_borrow_mut(|calls| calls.remove(&id)) {
            // A cancelled action has already dropped its receiver.
            let _ = sender.try_send(result);
        }
    }

    ## Shared identifier format
    
    A constructor can accept an entropy function without adding a context dependency to the compact crate.
    The shared identifier preserves the text representation in both backups and action payloads.
    A retry after restart uses the identifier from the saved submission.
    
    ## Order of nested action updates
    
    An action normally returns its view updates when it completes.
    A pending preview needs delivery before the child request starts.
    The native test records the number of delivered frames inside the transport send method.
    It also checks immediate reply delivery and a transport failure after the preview.

    package ewe.ui.android
    
    import ewe.ui.runtime.*
    import io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.FrameListener

    import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope

    class CoreBinding(private val native: NativeCore, store: NodeStore, scope: CoroutineScope) :
        ActionCore, AutoCloseable {
        init {
            native.setFrameListener(
                object : FrameListener {
                    override fun onFrame(frame: ByteArray) {
                        scope.launch { store.receive(frame) }
                    }
                }
            )
        }
    
        fun helloFor(tag: ULong): ByteArray = native.helloFor(tag)
    
        override fun hello() = native.hello()
    
        override fun applyCapsFrame(frame: ByteArray) = native.applyCapsFrame(frame)
    
        override suspend fun trigger(reference: String, event: EventInput): ByteArray? {
            val input = io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.EventInput(
                event.nodeId, event.eventName, event.value, event.checked, event.parentNode, event.state
            )
            val json = event.json ?: return native.trigger(reference, input)
            return native.triggerStructured(reference, input, json)
        }
    
        override fun close() {
            try {
                native.clearFrameListener()
            } finally {
                native.close()
            }
        }
    }

      #busy = new Set();

      constructor(deps) {
        this.deps = deps;
        if (deps.server?.handle && deps.server instanceof WebSocketActionTransport) {
          let reconnect = false;
          deps.server.onReply = bytes => this.receive(bytes).catch(error => this.onError({code: "Transport", detail: String(error)}));
          deps.server.onDisconnect = detail => {
            reconnect = true;
            this.#advertised = new Set();
            this.#structured = false;
            this.onError({code: "Transport", detail: String(detail)});
          };
          deps.server.onOpen = async () => {
            if (!reconnect) return;
            reconnect = false;
            try { for (const reply of await deps.server.send(this.hello())) await this.receive(reply); }
            catch (error) { this.onError({code: "Transport", detail: String(error)}); }
          };
        }
        this.streamId = deps.streamId ?? 0n;
        this.onError = deps.onError ?? console.error;
        this.limit = deps.maxRequestBytes ?? 1024 * 1024;
        const hooks = deps.frames?.deps;
        if (hooks) {
          const previousCaps = hooks.onCaps;
          const previousError = hooks.onError;
          const caps = value => { previousCaps?.(value); this.applyCaps(value); };
          const failure = detail => {
            if (previousError !== this.onError) previousError?.(detail);
            this.reportControl(detail);
          };
          hooks.onCaps = caps;
          hooks.onError = failure;
          this.detachControls = () => {
            if (hooks.onCaps === caps) hooks.onCaps = previousCaps;
            if (hooks.onError === failure) hooks.onError = previousError;
          };
        }
      }

    //! Version four universally unique identifiers (UUIDs).
    //!
    //! Use [`UuidV4::from_entropy`] with the entropy source from the host context.
    //! Use [`new_v4`] for platform entropy.
    
    use ::uuid::Builder;
    
    pub use ::uuid::Uuid;
    
    /// Generate a random version-4 UUID from the platform entropy source.
    ///
    /// The 16 bytes come from [`crate::entropy::fill`]; [`Builder::from_random_bytes`]
    /// sets the version-4 and RFC 4122 variant bits. The result is a plain value, so
    /// callers that need the canonical string call `.to_string()`.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    ///
    /// Returns [`crate::entropy::Error`] if the platform entropy source is
    /// unavailable.
    pub fn new_v4() -> Result<Uuid, crate::entropy::Error> {
        Ok(UuidV4::from_entropy(crate::entropy::fill)?.0)
    }
    
    /// A version four UUID with the standard variant.
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", serde(try_from = "String", into = "String"))]
    pub struct UuidV4(Uuid);
    
    impl UuidV4 {
        /// Generate an identifier with the entropy source supplied by the caller.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// Returns the entropy source error.
        pub fn from_entropy<E>(fill: impl FnOnce(&mut [u8]) -> Result<(), E>) -> Result<Self, E> {
            let mut bytes = [0; 16];
            fill(&mut bytes)?;
            Ok(Self(Builder::from_random_bytes(bytes).into_uuid()))
        }
    }
    
    impl core::str::FromStr for UuidV4 {
        type Err = &'static str;
    
        fn from_str(value: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
            let invalid = "Expected a version four UUID";
            let id = Uuid::try_parse(value).map_err(|_| invalid)?;
            if id.get_version_num() != 4 || id.get_variant() != ::uuid::Variant::RFC4122 {
                return Err(invalid);
            }
            Ok(Self(id))
        }
    }
    
    impl core::fmt::Display for UuidV4 {
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
            self.0.fmt(f)
        }
    }
    
    impl TryFrom<String> for UuidV4 {
        type Error = &'static str;
    
        fn try_from(value: String) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
            value.parse()
        }
    }
    
    impl From<UuidV4> for String {
        fn from(value: UuidV4) -> Self {

    #[action(server)]
    async fn toggle_todo(ctx: &Context, event: Interaction<()>) -> ActionResult {
        let id = todo_id(&event.input_value)?;
        mutate(ctx, |state| {
            let mut item = state
                .items
                .iter()
                .find(|row| row.id == id)
                .cloned()
                .ok_or_else(|| error("Todo does not exist"))?;
            item.done = !item.done;
            Ok(RecordChange::Upsert(item))
        })
    }
    
    #[action(server)]
    async fn confirm_delete(ctx: &Context, event: Interaction<(), TodoId>) -> ActionResult {
        let id = event.input_value;
        mutate(ctx, |state| {
            if !state.removed.contains_key(&id) && !state.items.iter().any(|row| row.id == id) {
                return Err(error("Todo does not exist"));
            }
            Ok(RecordChange::Remove(id))
        })?;
        TodoDelivery::Deleted { id }.send(ctx)
    }
    
    fn todo_id(input: &str) -> Result<TodoId, ErrorTrace<ActionError>> {
        input
            .parse()
            .map_err(|reason| ErrorTrace::new(ActionError::new(ErrorCode::InvalidInput, reason)))
    }

    async fn initialize_todos(ctx: &Context, _event: Interaction<()>) -> ActionResult {
        pending::restore(ctx).await?;
        app(ctx, &todo_store(ctx)?.snapshot())
    }

    test("fetch reads split prefixes and frames, including multiple frames per chunk", async () => {
      let sent;
      const frame = Uint8Array.of(0,0,0,0,69,87,70,49);
      const body = new ReadableStream({ start(controller) {
        for (const bytes of [[8,0], [0,0,0], [...frame.slice(1),8,0,0,0,...frame]]) controller.enqueue(Uint8Array.from(bytes));
        controller.close();
      }});
      const transport = new FetchActionTransport({url:"/action", csrfToken:"token", hello:() => Uint8Array.of(255),
        fetch:(url, init) => { sent = {url, init}; return new Response(body); }});
      const bytes = Uint8Array.of(5);
      assert.deepEqual(await transport.send(bytes), [frame, frame]);
      assert.equal(sent.init.headers["x-ewe-hello"], "_w");
      assert.equal(sent.init.headers["x-csrf-token"], "token");
      assert.equal(sent.init.body, bytes);
    });
    test("http failure checks status before reading, and deadline retries need a policy", async () => {
      let calls = 0;
      const bad = {status:503, body:{cancel(){}, getReader(){ assert.fail("error body read"); }}};
      const fetch = () => { calls++; return bad; };
      await assert.rejects(new FetchActionTransport({fetch}).send(new Uint8Array()), /503/);
      assert.equal(calls, 1);
      calls = 0;
      const timeout = {fetch:(_, {signal}) => {calls++; signal.throwIfAborted();}, requestSignal:() => AbortSignal.abort(Error("deadline"))};
      await assert.rejects(new FetchActionTransport(timeout).send(new Uint8Array()), /deadline/);
      assert.equal(calls, 1);
      calls = 0;
      await assert.rejects(new FetchActionTransport({...timeout, retry:(_, attempt) => attempt < 2}).send(new Uint8Array()), /deadline/);
      assert.equal(calls, 2);
    });

    test("wasm calls complete in reverse order, free late replies and support slot zero", async () => {
      let next = 0n;
      const memory = new Uint8Array(100);
      const slots = new Set(), calls = [];
      const bridge = {memory:() => memory, exports:{
        create_allocation() {const slot = next++; slots.add(slot); return slot;},
        allocation_start_pointer: Number, allocation_length: () => 1,
        dispose_allocation(slot) {assert.ok(slots.delete(slot));},
        ewe_ui_action(call, slot) {calls.push(call); this.dispose_allocation(slot); return 0;},
      }};
      const transport = new WasmActionTransport(bridge);
      const first = transport.send(Uint8Array.of(8)), second = transport.send(Uint8Array.of(9));
      function finish(call, slot, value) {slots.add(slot); memory[Number(slot)] = value; transport.complete(call, slot);}
      finish(calls[1], 0n, 4);
      finish(calls[0], 2n, 5);
      assert.deepEqual(await first, [Uint8Array.of(5)]);
      assert.deepEqual(await second, [Uint8Array.of(4)]);
      const missing = transport.send(Uint8Array.of(1));
      transport.complete(calls.at(-1), -1n);
      await assert.rejects(missing, /failed/);
      const pending = transport.send(Uint8Array.of(1));
      transport.close();
      await assert.rejects(pending, /closed/);
      finish(calls.at(-1), 2n, 7);
      assert.equal(slots.size, 0);

    fn take_request(raw: u64) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        internal_api::with_global_allocations(|arena| {
            let id = MemoryId::from_u64(raw);
            let bytes = arena.get(id).ok()?.take();
            arena.deallocate(id).ok()?;
            bytes
        })
    }
    
    fn reply_slot(bytes: Vec<u8>) -> Option<u64> {
        internal_api::with_global_allocations(|arena| {
            let id = arena.allocate(0).ok()?;
            if let Some(()) = arena
                .get(id)
                .ok()
                .and_then(|slot| slot.into_with(|buffer| *buffer = bytes))
            {
                return Some(id.as_u64());
            }
            arena.deallocate(id).ok()?;

    //! Save unconfirmed Todo requests before a host sends them.
    use super::{dialog, error, todo_store, AddInput, StoreState};
    use foundation_context::Ctx;
    use foundation_errstacks::ErrorTrace;
    use foundation_ui_runtime::action::{ActionError, ActionResult, Context, Interaction};
    use foundation_ui_wire::ErrorCode;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
    
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub enum PendingChange {
        Add {
            #[serde(alias = "creation_id")]
            id: super::TodoId,
            title: String,
        },
        Delete {
            id: super::TodoId,
        },
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Pending {
        pub change: PendingChange,
        pub retry: bool,
        #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
        pub validation: Option<String>,
    }
    
    type Entries = BTreeMap<String, Pending>;
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait]
    pub trait PendingStorage: Send + Sync {
        async fn load(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String>;
        async fn save(&self, contents: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), String>;
    }
    
    #[derive(Default)]
    pub(super) struct MemoryStorage(Mutex<Vec<u8>>);
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait]
    impl PendingStorage for MemoryStorage {
        async fn load(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
            Ok(self
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner)
                .clone())
        }
        async fn save(&self, contents: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), String> {
            *self
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner) = contents;
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    
    struct Outbox {
        storage: Arc<dyn PendingStorage>,
        initialized: futures_util::lock::Mutex<bool>,
    }
    
    /// Install the storage selected by this host.
    pub fn install_pending_storage(ctx: &Ctx, storage: Arc<dyn PendingStorage>) {
        ctx.store(Outbox {
            storage,
            initialized: futures_util::lock::Mutex::new(false),
        });
    }
    
    async fn change_pending<T>(
        ctx: &Context,
        change: impl FnOnce(&mut Entries) -> Result<(bool, T), ErrorTrace<ActionError>>,
    ) -> Result<T, ErrorTrace<ActionError>> {
        let store = todo_store(ctx)?;
        let outbox = ctx
            .get::<Outbox>()
            .ok_or_else(|| error("Missing Todo pending storage"))?;
        let mut initialized = outbox.initialized.lock().await;
        let mut entries = if *initialized {
            store
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner)
                .pending
                .clone()
        } else {
            let bytes = outbox.storage.load().await.map_err(|e| error(&e))?;
            if bytes.is_empty() {
                Entries::new()
            } else {
                let mut entries: Entries =
                    serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|e| error(&e.to_string()))?;
                for entry in entries.values_mut() {
                    entry.retry = true;
                }
                entries
            }
        };
        let (changed, result) = change(&mut entries)?;
        if changed {
            outbox
                .storage
                .save(serde_json::to_vec(&entries).map_err(|e| error(&e.to_string()))?)
                .await
                .map_err(|e| error(&e))?;
        }
        store
            .0
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner)
            .pending = entries;
        *initialized = true;
        Ok(result)
    }

        change_pending(ctx, |_| Ok((false, ()))).await

    //! Store pending changes in the application directory.
    use std::io::Write;
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    
    pub(super) struct FileStorage(pub(super) PathBuf);
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait]
    impl crate::PendingStorage for FileStorage {
        async fn load(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
            let path = self.0.clone();
            blocking::unblock(move || match std::fs::read(path) {
                Ok(bytes) => Ok(bytes),
                Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(vec![]),
                Err(error) => Err(error.to_string()),
            })
            .await
        }
    
        async fn save(&self, contents: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), String> {
            let path = self.0.clone();
            blocking::unblock(move || -> std::io::Result<()> {
                let parent = path
                    .parent()
                    .ok_or_else(|| std::io::Error::other("Missing outbox directory"))?;
                std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
                let mut file = tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in(parent)?;
                file.write_all(&contents)?;
                file.as_file().sync_all()?;
                file.persist(&path).map_err(|e| e.error)?;
                std::fs::File::open(parent)?.sync_all()
            })
            .await
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
        }
    }

    async function connectSender() {
        const { default: initialize, BrowserConnectSender } = await import("/rpc/foundation_ui_connectrpc.js");
        await initialize();
        const sender = new BrowserConnectSender(location.origin, window.fetch.bind(window));
        return { async send(bytes) {
            const reply = await sender.exchange(bytes);
            return reply === undefined ? [] : [reply];
        } };
    }
    
    let resourceHost;
    
    async function installResources() {
        const { default: initialize, BrowserResources } = await import("/resources-wasm/foundation_resources.js");
        await initialize();
        return new BrowserResources(new URL("/", location.href).href);
    }
    
    // Return the next bytes only when the caller reads the stream.
    export async function openResource(name) {
        resourceHost ??= installResources().catch(error => {
            resourceHost = undefined;
            throw error;
        });
        return (await resourceHost).open(name);
    }
    
    async function boot() {
        const runtime = new FoundationWasm();
        const dom = new ui.DomHeap({ window, document });
        let local;
        const storageKey = "ewe.todo.pending.v1";
        const encoder = new TextEncoder(), decoder = new TextDecoder();
        const memory = (offset, length) => new Uint8Array(instance.exports.memory.buffer, offset, length);
        let stored;
        const registry = new JsActionRegistry();
        const imports = {
            abi: { ...runtime.web_abi, ...ui.domAbi(runtime, dom) },
            env: {
                ewe_todo_storage_size() {
                    try { stored = encoder.encode(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) ?? ""); return stored.length; }
                    catch { return -1; }
                },
                ewe_todo_storage_read(offset, length) {
                    if (!stored || stored.length !== length) return -1;
                    memory(offset, length).set(stored); stored = undefined; return 0;
                },
                ewe_todo_storage_save(offset, length) {
                    try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, decoder.decode(memory(offset, length))); return 0; }
                    catch { return -1; }

    // WasmLoader + AsyncTaskCollector against the real e2e fixture: loadBytes binds the
    // bridge exactly like the manual instantiate pattern, and enabled task collection
    // makes awaitTasks() settle after async invocations deliver their callbacks.
    
    import { test } from "node:test";
    import assert from "node:assert/strict";
    import { readFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
    import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
    import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
    
    import { WasmLoader, AsyncTaskCollector } from "../../runtime/foundation-wasm.js";
    
    const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
    const wasmPath = join(here, "..", "fixtures", "foundation_wasm_e2e.wasm");
    const skip = existsSync(wasmPath) ? false : "wasm fixture not built (run ./build-module.sh)";
    
    test("WasmLoader.loadBytes instantiates + binds the runtime bridge", { skip }, async () => {
      const loader = await new WasmLoader().loadBytes(readFileSync(wasmPath));
      assert.equal(loader.runtime.bridge.exports, loader.module.instance.exports);
      assert.equal(loader.module.instance.exports.roundtrip_i32(21), 42);
    });
    
    test("WasmLoader.run throws without a module or a main export", { skip }, async () => {
      assert.throws(() => new WasmLoader().run(), /No wasm module loaded/);
      const loader = await new WasmLoader().loadBytes(readFileSync(wasmPath));
      assert.throws(() => loader.run(), /no exported main/); // fixture has no main()
    });
    
    test("awaitTasks settles after async invocation callbacks deliver", { skip }, async () => {
      const loader = await new WasmLoader().loadBytes(readFileSync(wasmPath));
      const rt = loader.runtime;
      rt.tasks.enable();
      const calls = [];
      rt.callbacks.invoke = (id, data) => calls.push({ id, data: Uint8Array.from(data) });
    
      loader.module.instance.exports.invoke_async_test(3n);
      assert.equal(rt.tasks.tasks.length, 1);
      await rt.awaitTasks();
      assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
      assert.equal(calls[0].id, 3n);
    });
    
    test("AsyncTaskCollector is off by default and validates inputs", () => {
      const tasks = new AsyncTaskCollector();
      tasks.add(Promise.resolve(1)); // collection off — not retained
      assert.equal(tasks.tasks.length, 0);
      tasks.enable();
      tasks.add(Promise.resolve(2));
      assert.equal(tasks.tasks.length, 1);
      assert.throws(() => tasks.add(42), /must be a Promise/);
      tasks.clear();
      assert.equal(tasks.tasks.length, 0);
    });

    //! WHY: The crate that defines the UI runtime owns how it ships (feature 20)
    //! — including a standalone CLI, so `cargo install foundation_wasm_ui` is all
    //! a consumer needs.
    //!
    //! WHAT: `ewe-wasm-bundle` — the `foundation_wasm_ui::cli` surface
    //! (`build`, `plan`) as its own binary.
    
    #[cfg(not(target_family = "wasm"))]
    fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
        #[cfg(feature = "tasks")]
        if std::env::args_os().nth(1).as_deref() == Some(std::ffi::OsStr::new("task")) {
            return foundation_tasks::run_entry("ewe-wasm-bundle", |mut runner| {
                Box::pin(async move {
                    runner.register(foundation_wasm_ui::tasks::set()?)?;
                    runner.run().await
                })
            });
        }
        tracing_subscriber::fmt().with_target(false).init();
        let matches = foundation_wasm_ui::cli::command().get_matches();
        if let Err(error) = foundation_wasm_ui::cli::run(&matches) {
            tracing::error!("ewe-wasm-bundle: {error}");
            return std::process::ExitCode::FAILURE;
        }
        std::process::ExitCode::SUCCESS
    }
    
    // Cargo builds every target on `--target wasm32-*` too; the CLI is native

    #[cfg(target_family = "wasm")]
    fn main() {}

    //! `StorageProvider` — unified runtime backend selector (both native + wasm).
    //!
    //! This is the central export of `foundation_db`. It wraps all available
    //! backends behind feature gates and implements the `Async*` storage traits
    //! over whichever one is selected.
    
    use foundation_context::Ctx;
    use serde::{de::DeserializeOwned, Serialize};
    
    // Core backends (shared — both targets)
    use crate::core::backends::memory::MemoryStorage;
    use crate::core::backends::memory_json::MemoryJsonStore;
    
    #[cfg(all(feature = "d1", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
    use crate::native::d1_kvstore::D1Store;
    
    #[cfg(all(feature = "r2", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
    use crate::native::r2_blobstore::R2Store;
    
    // Native-only backends
    #[cfg(all(feature = "turso", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
    use crate::native::turso_backend::TursoStorage;
    
    #[cfg(all(feature = "libsql", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
    use crate::native::libsql_store::LibsqlStore;
    
    #[cfg(json_file_backend)]
    use crate::native::json_file::JsonFileStorage;
    
    // Wasm-bindgen storage backends (wasm32 only)
    #[cfg(all(target_family = "wasm", feature = "wasm-bindgen-storage"))]
    use crate::wasm::wasm_storage::{D1WasmStorage, KVWasmStorage, R2WasmStorage};
    
    #[allow(unused_imports)] // used only in R2 match arms
    use crate::core::errors::StorageError;
    use crate::core::errors::StorageResult;

        AsyncListStream, AsyncQueryStream, BlobStore, DataValue, KeyValueStore, QueryStore,
        RateLimiterStore,
    };
    
    /// The [`Ctx`] a SQL backend reads its clock from, with a `Debug` impl.
    ///
    /// WHY: `Ctx` has no `Debug` impl, and `StorageBackend` derives it.
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct BackendCtx(pub Ctx);
    
    impl std::fmt::Debug for BackendCtx {
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
            f.write_str("BackendCtx(..)")
        }
    }
    
    impl From<Ctx> for BackendCtx {
        fn from(ctx: Ctx) -> Self {
            Self(ctx)
        }
    }
    
    /// Storage backend enumeration for runtime selection.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub enum StorageBackend {
        /// Turso backend with database URL (native only). `ctx` times the lock wait.
        #[cfg(all(feature = "turso", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
        Turso { url: String, ctx: BackendCtx },
        /// libsql backend with database URL (native only). `ctx` times the lock wait.
        #[cfg(all(feature = "libsql", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
        Libsql { url: String, ctx: BackendCtx },
        #[cfg(all(feature = "d1", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
        D1,
        /// Cloudflare R2 backend with bucket configuration (native only).
        #[cfg(all(feature = "r2", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
        R2 { bucket: String },
        /// JSON file backend with file path.
        ///
        /// The backend needs filesystem access. A wasm target with the WebAssembly
        /// System Interface (WASI) has this access, so `JsonFile` stays there.
        /// `wasm32-unknown-unknown` has no filesystem access, so `JsonFile` is

        private val cleanup = mutableListOf<() -> Unit>(store::close)
        var status by mutableStateOf(loading)
            private set
        var graphics: (() -> io.github.ewe_studios.ewe.core.NativeGraphics)? = null
            private set
        var bridge by mutableStateOf<EventBridge?>(null)
            private set
    
        init {
            store.onError = { code, message -> status = "$code $message" }
        }
    
        fun start(setup: suspend (ScreenHost) -> Unit) {
            scope.launch {
                try {
                    setup(this@ScreenHost)
                } catch (cancel: CancellationException) {
                    throw cancel
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    status = error.message ?: "Screen setup failed"
                }
            }
        }
    
        fun onClose(clean: () -> Unit) {
            cleanup.add(clean)
        }
    
        fun attach(core: NativeCore, channels: ChannelFactory?, manager: ConnectionManager? = null, viewDataAction: String? = null): CoreBinding {
            val binding = try {
                core.installWebSockets(ewe.ui.android.AppWebSockets())
                CoreBinding(core, store, scope)
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                core.close()
                throw error
            }
            if (viewDataAction != null) {
                require(viewDataAction.startsWith("host:"))
                val queue = kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel<Pair<UInt, ByteArray>>(kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel.BUFFERED)
                store.onData = { id, message ->
                    message.msgpack?.let { packet ->
                        val json = (0 until packet.bytesLength).joinToString(",", "[", "]") { packet.bytes(it).toString() }
                        queue.trySend(id to json.toByteArray()).getOrThrow()
                    }
                }
                onClose { store.onData = null; queue.close() }
                scope.launch {
                    for ((id, json) in queue) {
                        try {
                            val event = EventInput(id, "data", "", false, 0u, byteArrayOf(), json)
                            binding.trigger(viewDataAction, event)?.let { check(store.receive(it, id)) { "Invalid view data reply" } }
                        } catch (cancel: CancellationException) { throw cancel }
                        catch (error: Exception) { store.onError?.invoke("ViewData", error.message.orEmpty()) }
                    }
                }
            }
            graphics = core::graphics
            onClose(binding::close)
            bridge = EventBridge(store, binding, scope)
            val factory = channels ?: object : ChannelFactory {
                override fun open(
                    endpoint: String,
                    transport: UByte,
                    streamId: ULong,
                    resumeFrom: ULong,
                    onFrame: (ByteArray) -> Unit,
                    onClose: (Throwable?) -> Unit,
                ): Channel = error("A local screen cannot open a remote channel")
            }
            val mounts = LiveMountHost(store, factory, manager)
            onClose(mounts::close)
            return binding
        }
    
        fun apply(frame: ByteArray, name: String) {
            check(store.receive(frame)) { "Invalid $name frame: ${store.reports.lastOrNull()}" }

    /** Sends one HTTP action and returns its complete reply to the native core. */
    class HttpActionConnection(
        private val client: OkHttpClient,
        private val base: HttpUrl,
        private val actionPath: String = "action",
        private val maxFrameBytes: Int = 4 * 1024 * 1024,
    ) : HostTransport {
        private lateinit var hello: ByteArray
    
        fun configure(frame: ByteArray) { hello = frame.copyOf() }
    
        suspend fun negotiate(core: ActionCore): ByteArray {
            hello = core.hello()
            return post(hello)
        }
    
        override suspend fun send(request: ByteArray): ByteArray = post(request)
    
        suspend fun initial(path: String): ByteArray = exchange(path, null)
    
        private suspend fun post(frame: ByteArray) = exchange(actionPath, frame)
    
        private suspend fun exchange(path: String, frame: ByteArray?): ByteArray =
            suspendCancellableCoroutine { pending ->
                val request = Request.Builder().url(requireNotNull(base.resolve(path)))
                request.header(
                    "X-Ewe-Hello",
                    Base64.encodeToString(hello, Base64.NO_PADDING or Base64.NO_WRAP or Base64.URL_SAFE),
                )
                if (frame != null) request.post(frame.toRequestBody("application/primal-frame".toMediaType()))
                else request.header("Accept", "application/vnd.ewe.frame")
                val call = client.newCall(request.build())
                pending.invokeOnCancellation { call.cancel() }
                call.enqueue(object : Callback {
                    override fun onFailure(call: Call, error: IOException) {
                        pending.resumeWithException(error)
                    }

    //! Configure the host and publish the list and count after a successful change.
    use super::Error;
    use crate::{TodoDelivery, TodoStore};
    use foundation_context::Ctx;
    use foundation_ui_http::ActionRequestPolicy;
    use foundation_ui_runtime::action::{prepare_messages, ActionError, Context};
    use foundation_ui_wire::{writer::WriterConfig, ActionRequest, ErrorCode};
    use foundation_wasm_ui::server::{BacklogConfig, LiveChannel};
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub(crate) struct TodoFeed(pub(super) LiveChannel);
    
    impl TodoFeed {
        pub(crate) fn publish(&self, ctx: &Ctx, change: &crate::RecordChange) -> Result<u64, Error> {
            self.0.sender().push_with(|position| {
                let view = Context::for_render(ctx.clone());
                TodoDelivery::Committed {
                    position,
                    change: change.clone(),
                }
                .send(&view)?;
                Ok(prepare_messages(ctx, view.into_receiver().drain())?)
            })
        }
    }
    
    struct BusinessActions;
    impl ActionRequestPolicy for BusinessActions {
        fn check(&self, _: &Ctx, action: ActionRequest<'_>) -> Result<(), ActionError> {
            if action.state().is_some() {
                return Err(ActionError::new(
                    ErrorCode::StateRejected,
                    "Business actions reject presentation state",
                ));
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    
    pub(super) fn install(ctx: &Ctx, web: LiveChannel, store: TodoStore) -> Result<TodoFeed, Error> {
        if web.stream_id() != 1 {
            return Err("The todo page listens to stream 1".into());
        }
        crate::install_view_services(ctx, foundation_ui_runtime::action::Origin::Server)?;
        ctx.store(store);
        ctx.store(Arc::new(BusinessActions) as Arc<dyn ActionRequestPolicy>);
        let channels = TodoFeed(web);
        let feed = channels.0.clone();
        ctx.store(foundation_ui_runtime::dispatch::SubscriptionReplay::new(
            move |_, _| vec![Arc::new(feed.clone())],
        ));
        ctx.store(channels.clone());
        Ok(channels)
    }
    
    pub(super) fn channel(id: u64) -> LiveChannel {
        LiveChannel::new(id, BacklogConfig::default(), WriterConfig::default())
    }
    
    pub(super) struct Todos;
    impl crate::todo_rpc::Todos for Todos {
        #[expect(
            clippy::unused_async_trait_impl,
            reason = "The generated service has an asynchronous contract."
        )]
        async fn get_todo(
            &self,
            ctx: foundation_connectrpc::RpcCtx,
            request: foundation_connectrpc::Request<crate::todo_rpc::GetTodoRequest>,
        ) -> foundation_connectrpc::ConnectResult<foundation_connectrpc::Response<crate::todo_rpc::Todo>>
        {
            use foundation_connectrpc::{ConnectError, Response};
            let id = request
                .msg
                .id
                .parse::<crate::TodoId>()
                .map_err(ConnectError::invalid_argument)?;
            let store = ctx
                .ctx
                .get::<TodoStore>()
                .ok_or_else(|| ConnectError::internal("Missing todo store"))?;
            let todo = store
                .snapshot()
                .items
                .into_iter()
                .find(|todo| todo.id == id)
                .ok_or_else(|| ConnectError::not_found("Todo not found"))?;
            Ok(Response::new(crate::todo_rpc::Todo {
                id: todo.id.to_string(),
                title: todo.text,
                ..Default::default()
            }))
        }
    }

    mod services;
    pub(crate) use services::TodoFeed;
    
    #[foundation_ui_http::get("/initial")]
    fn initial(req: ViewRequest) -> Result<Response, Error> {
        let feed = req.require::<TodoFeed>()?;
        let (state, cursor, retired_ids) = req.require::<TodoStore>()?.published_snapshot(&feed.0);
        let ctx = req.render_context();
        let page = screens::page(&state, feed.0.stream_id(), cursor);
        foundation_ui_runtime::view::full_view(&ctx, ctx.receiver(), &page, None::<&()>)?;
        crate::TodoDelivery::Snapshot {
            position: cursor,
            items: state.items,
            retired_ids,
        }
        .send(&ctx)?;
        Ok(Response::frame(ctx))
    }
    
    #[foundation_ui_http::get("/open-count")]
    fn count_screen(req: ViewRequest) -> Result<Response, Error> {
        let state = req.require::<TodoStore>()?.snapshot();
        let count = state.items.iter().filter(|item| !item.done).count();
        Ok(Response::frame(screens::starter(count)))
    }

    impl NativeCore {
        /// Creates a core for a foreign application that calls actions on a server.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// Rejects duplicate or invalid server action names.
        #[uniffi::constructor]
        pub fn remote(
            platform: NativePlatform,
            names: Vec<String>,
            transport: Arc<dyn HostTransport>,
        ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, CoreError> {
            let mut registry = ActionRegistry::new();
            registry
                .register(crate::graphics::handoff::GraphicsReady)
                .map_err(CoreError::write)?;
            for name in names {
                registry
                    .declare(Some(Origin::Server), &name, Scope::All)
                    .map_err(|e| CoreError::BadReference {
                        detail: e.to_string(),
                    })?;
            }
            Ok(Self::new(
                CoreConfig {
                    ctx: Ctx::host(),
                    registry: Arc::new(registry),
                    platform,
                    writer: WriterConfig::default(),
                },
                Some(transport),
            ))
        }

        ## Feature 37 three-client verification
        
        Chrome, iPhone, and Android each sent changes that reached the other two clients.

    def shell(*args, command_timeout=10):
        return subprocess.check_output(
            [adb, "-s", device, "shell", *args], text=True, timeout=command_timeout
        )
    
    
    def wait_for(*present, absent=(), condition=lambda _: True):
        snapshot = "/sdcard/ewe-todo.xml"
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        visible = {}
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                report = shell("uiautomator", "dump", snapshot)
                if snapshot not in report:
                    continue
                nodes = list(ET.fromstring(shell("cat", snapshot)).iter("node"))
                visible = {
                    node.get("text"): node
                    for node in nodes
                    if node.get("package") == app and node.get("text")
                }
                for node in nodes:
                    if node.get("package") == app:
                        if node.get("content-desc"):
                            visible.setdefault(node.get("content-desc"), node)
                        if node.get("class") == "android.widget.EditText":
                            visible.setdefault("<editor>", node)
                if all(label in visible for label in present) and all(label not in visible for label in absent) and condition(visible):
                    return visible
            except (ET.ParseError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.5)
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{app} expected {present} and absent {absent}. Visible: {list(visible)}"
        )

    ## ⚡ Fast Rust Check Workflow
    
    **CRITICAL:** When doing Rust checks and you're not sure about something, use quick `cargo check` with `tee` to collect warnings rapidly. **5-6 minutes should be enough** for the initial pass. If after 5-6 minutes you see nothing, increase to 10 minutes on the next run. If it finishes with no issues — great. If you see issues early, collect enough in 5 minutes then go fix them. This increases iteration speed and reduces wasted wait time.
    
    ---
    
    ## Crate Hygiene: Check + Clippy Per Crate
    
    When you finish a crate, clear its warnings before you call the work done. You
    
    ```js
    const module = await loadWasm("/module.wasm");
    const app = createApp({ module, mount, initialRoute, storage });
    await app.boot();
    ```
    
    1. The loader checks response status before compiling. Return a typed load error for missing, malformed, or incompatible modules.
    2. Boot supplies imports, attaches memory, installs the Rust host context and selected services, and registers the application's declared actions.
    3. The application supplies its mount, initial route, typed delivery action, and optional capabilities through configuration.
    4. Use the default transport or register a custom transport before boot. Applications supply endpoint choices through configuration.
    5. The runtime owns the handshake, frames, socket acknowledgements, request correlation, disconnect handling, initial load, and recovery.
    6. Accept serializable JavaScript values and typed Rust action inputs. Keep transport errors available through the public action call.
    7. Dispose partial startup on failure. Repeated startup must not register duplicate handlers or leave open connections.
    
    Remove Todo-specific storage imports, pointer callbacks, numeric scope translation, and prepared-request callbacks from `src/web.rs`.
    Remove manual module instantiation, frame inspection, send overrides, and socket callback replacement from `web/app.js`.
    The framework can use native browser bindings internally. Application authors use its public interfaces.
    
    Test a missing module, a successful response containing an error page, and an invalid WebAssembly binary.
    Verify that no host starts after a load failure. Preserve the request address and the available status or compiler cause.
    Boot a minimal external app with the default transport. Repeat with a registered custom transport.

    #[async_trait::async_trait]
    impl crate::PendingStorage for BrowserStorage {
        async fn load(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
            // The host reports storage errors with a negative length.
            let size = usize::try_from(unsafe { ewe_todo_storage_size() })
                .map_err(|_| "Cannot read pending Todos")?;
            let mut bytes = vec![0; size];
            // The initialized buffer is valid for this synchronous host copy.
            if unsafe { ewe_todo_storage_read(bytes.as_mut_ptr(), bytes.len()) } != 0 {
                return Err("Cannot read pending Todos".into());
            }
            Ok(bytes)
        }
    
        async fn save(&self, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), String> {
            // The host copies this slice before returning.
            if unsafe { ewe_todo_storage_save(bytes.as_ptr(), bytes.len()) } != 0 {
                return Err("Cannot save pending Todos".into());
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

        #[cfg(target_family = "wasm")]

            single::initialize_pool_with_ctx(0, self.0.context().clone());
            let local = Arc::new(self.0);

                        .submit_with_caller(bytes, Some(Arc::new(child::BrowserCaller(id))))
                },
                notify_completion,
            );

        #[must_use]

        }
    }

    const error = code => ({ error: code });
    
    export function parseReference(text) {
      if (typeof text !== "string") return error("InvalidReference");
      const [origin, name, extra] = text.split(":");
      if (extra !== undefined || !["host", "server"].includes(origin) || !validName(name)) {
        return error("InvalidReference");
      }
      return { origin, name };

    export class JsActionRegistry {
      #entries = new Map();
    
      declare(origin, name, scope = "all", local = origin === "host") {
        if (![null, "host", "server"].includes(origin) || !validName(name) || !["all", "web", "mobile"].includes(scope)) {
          throw new TypeError("Invalid action declaration");
        }
        const entries = this.#entries.get(name) ?? [];
        if (entries.some(e => (e.origin === null || origin === null || e.origin === origin)
            && (scope === "all" || e.scope === "all" || e.scope === scope))) {
          throw new Error("Duplicate action declaration");
        }
        entries.push({ origin, scope, local, page: false });
        this.#entries.set(name, entries);
      }
    
      declarePage(name) {
        this.declare("host", name, "web", true);
        this.lookup("host", name, "web").page = true;
      }
    
      registerHost(name, fn, owner) {
        if (typeof fn !== "function") throw new TypeError("Expected a page function");
        let entry = this.lookup("host", name, "web");
        if (entry.error) {

        const sameOwner = owner && (entry.owner === owner || (ownerId != null && ownerId === entry.ownerId));

        }

    //! Build the example application service for its server and mobile clients.
    #[cfg(feature = "server")]

    mod runtime_build;
    
    fn write_changed(path: &std::path::Path, contents: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        match std::fs::metadata(path) {
            Ok(info)
                if info.len() == contents.len() as u64
                    && std::fs::read(path)? == contents.as_bytes() =>
            {
                return Ok(())
            }
            Ok(_) => {}
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        }
        std::fs::write(path, contents)
    }
    
    fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        #[cfg(any(feature = "server", feature = "mobile"))]
        foundation_connectrpc_codegen::build::compile_service("proto", "todos", "todo_service.rs")?;
        #[cfg(feature = "server")]
        {
            let runtime = std::path::Path::new("../../backends/foundation_wasm_ui/runtimes");

            for input in runtime_build::generate(runtime, std::path::Path::new(&output), false)? {
                println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", input.display());
            }
            println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=../../backends/foundation_wasm_ui/src/runtime_build.rs");
            println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs");
        }
        let output =
            std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("OUT_DIR").ok_or("Cargo did not set OUT_DIR")?);
        write_changed(&output.join("app-version.txt"), env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"))?;
        foundation_resources::build::stage_from_cargo()?;
        Ok(())
    }

        /** Start the configured view once. A failed start releases its resources and permits retry. */
        export function createApp(options) {
          let flight;
          let cleanup = [];
          function dispose() {
            const errors = [];
            while (cleanup.length) {
              try { cleanup.pop()(); } catch (error) { errors.push(error); }
            }
            flight = undefined;
            if (errors.length) throw new AggregateError(errors, "Browser app cleanup failed");
          }
          async function start() {
            const {mount, moduleLoader, onError = console.error} = options;
            const doc = mount.ownerDocument;
            const registry = new JsActionRegistry();
            const local = await WasmActionTransport.boot(moduleLoader, options.moduleUrl, {
              registry, start: options.start, imports: options.imports, window: doc.defaultView,
            });
            cleanup.push(() => moduleLoader.runtime.dispose(), () => local.close());
            const runtime = ui.Patcher.runtime;
            const connections = ui.frameConnections();
            cleanup.push(() => connections.close());
            const dispatcher = runtime.dispatcher;
            runtime.dispatcher = new ui.EventDispatcher(() => {});
            cleanup.push(() => { runtime.dispatcher = dispatcher; });
            const frames = installFrameRuntime(ui, {document: doc, connections, onReport: onError, viewMount: mount});
            cleanup.push(() => { if (runtime.frames === frames) runtime.frames = null; });
            ui.registerWebComponents();
            cleanup.push(frames.registerView(options.view, mount));
            let manager;
            const server = typeof options.transport === "function" ? await options.transport()
              : options.transport?.socket ? WebSocketActionTransport.connect(connections, options.transport.socket)
              : new FetchActionTransport({url: options.transport?.http ?? "/action", hello: () => manager.hello()});
            cleanup.push(() => server.close?.());
            manager = installActionRuntime(ui, {registry, frames, server, local, behaviours, document: doc, onError});
            cleanup.push(manager.dispose);
            if (options.viewDataAction) {
              const receive = event => {
                void manager.deliverViewData(options.viewDataAction, event.target, event.detail.bytes).catch(onError);
              };
              mount.addEventListener("ewe:data", receive);
              cleanup.push(() => mount.removeEventListener("ewe:data", receive));
            }
            for (const bytes of await server.send(manager.hello())) await manager.receive(bytes);
            const view = frames.registerLoader(mount, async signal => {
              const response = await fetch(options.initialRoute, {
                signal, headers: {"X-Ewe-Hello": base64urlEncode(manager.hello())},
              });
              return readViewResponse(response, frames.maxFrameBytes);
            }, {onError: error => onError({code: "ViewRecovery", detail: error.message})});
            await view.open();
            return manager;
          }
          return {
            boot() {
              flight ??= start().catch(error => { dispose(); throw error; });
              return flight;
            },
            async close() {
              if (flight) {
                try { await flight; } finally { dispose(); }
              }
            },
          };
        }

    //! Build the two classic scripts used by the browser host.
    use std::prelude::rust_2021::*;
    use std::{
        fs, io,
        path::{Path, PathBuf},
    };
    
    pub const READABLE: &str = "foundation-ui-runtime.js";
    pub const MINIFIED: &str = "foundation-ui-runtime.min.js";
    
    /// Generate the browser scripts or compare them with the destination files.
    pub fn generate(runtime: &Path, output: &Path, check: bool) -> io::Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {
        let bundle = foundation_codegen::javascript::bundle(&runtime.join("runtime-entry.js"))
            .map_err(|e| io::Error::other(format!("{e:#}")))?;
        if !check {
            fs::create_dir_all(output)?;
        }
        for (name, contents) in [(READABLE, bundle.readable), (MINIFIED, bundle.minified)] {
            let target = output.join(name);
            match fs::read(&target) {
                Ok(existing) if existing == contents => {}
                Err(e) if e.kind() != io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Err(e),
                _ if check => {
                    return Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                        "Generated file differs: {}",
                        target.display()
                    )));
                }
                _ => fs::write(&target, contents)?,
            }
        }
        Ok(bundle.inputs)
    }

    impl Resolve for LocalImports {
        fn resolve(&self, base: &FileName, specifier: &str) -> Result<Resolution> {
            let FileName::Real(path) = base else {
                bail!("Expected a local entry file")
            };
            if !specifier.starts_with("./") && !specifier.starts_with("../") {
                bail!(
                    "Unsupported module import {specifier:?} in {}",
                    path.display()
                )
            }
            let sibling = path.with_file_name(specifier);
            Ok(Resolution {
                filename: FileName::Real(
                    sibling
                        .canonicalize()
                        .with_context(|| format!("Cannot resolve {}", sibling.display()))?,
                ),
                slug: None,
            })
        }
    }

        // Exercise a standalone host with one initializer that returns success.
        (async () => {
            const {WasmLoader} = await import("/foundation-wasm.js");
            const {createApp, FetchActionTransport} = await import("/foundation-ui-actions.js");
            const moduleBytes = Uint8Array.of(
                0, 97, 115, 109, 1, 0, 0, 0,
                1, 5, 1, 96, 0, 1, 127,
                3, 2, 1, 0,
                7, 8, 1, 4, 98, 111, 111, 116, 0, 0,
                10, 6, 1, 4, 0, 65, 0, 11,
            );
            const moduleUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([moduleBytes], {type: "application/wasm"}));
            const mount = document.createElement("main");
            document.body.append(mount);
            const options = {
                moduleUrl, moduleLoader: new WasmLoader(), mount, view: "counter",
                initialRoute: "/open-count", start: "boot",
            };
            let opened = 0, closed = 0;
            try {
                const defaults = createApp(options);
                await defaults.boot();
                if (!mount.querySelector("#open-count")) throw Error("Missing default view");
                await defaults.close();
                const app = createApp({...options, initialRoute: "/missing-view", onError() {}, transport() {
                    opened++;
                    const transport = new FetchActionTransport({url: "/action"});
                    return {send: bytes => transport.send(bytes), close() { closed++; }};
                }});
                const first = app.boot();
                if (app.boot() !== first) throw Error("Startup created two flights");
                try { await first; } catch { /* This route does not exist. */ }
                if (opened !== 1 || closed !== 1) throw Error("Failed startup retained its transport");
                const recovered = createApp({...options, transport() {
                    opened++;
                    const transport = new FetchActionTransport({url: "/action"});
                    return {send: bytes => transport.send(bytes), close() { closed++; }};
                }});
                const results = await Promise.all([recovered.boot(), recovered.boot()]);
                if (results[0] !== results[1]) throw Error("Concurrent startup returned two managers");
                const count = Number(mount.querySelector("#open-count").textContent);
                await recovered.close();
                if (mount.childNodes.length) throw Error("Closing retained the view");
                return [opened, closed, count];
            } finally { URL.revokeObjectURL(moduleUrl); }
        })()

        fn load(&self, name: &FileName) -> Result<ModuleData> {
            let FileName::Real(path) = name else {
                bail!("Expected a local JavaScript file")
            };
            let fm = self
                .source
                .load_file(path)
                .with_context(|| format!("Cannot open {}", path.display()))?;
            let comments = SingleThreadedComments::default();
            let lexer = Lexer::new(
                Syntax::Es(EsSyntax::default()),
                EsVersion::Es2022,
                StringInput::from(&*fm),
                Some(&comments),
            );
            let mut parser = Parser::new_from(lexer);
            let module = parser
                .parse_module()
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("{}: {:?}", path.display(), e.kind()))?;
            if let Some(error) = parser.take_errors().first() {
                bail!("{}: {:?}", path.display(), error.kind())
            }
            self.inputs
                .lock()
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("input list unavailable"))?
                .insert(path.clone());
            let mut notices = self
                .notices
                .lock()
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("notice list unavailable"))?;
            let (leading, trailing) = comments.take_all();
            for list in [leading, trailing] {
                for comment in list.borrow().values().flatten() {
                    let text = comment.text.as_ref();
                    let words = text.to_ascii_lowercase();
                    if text.starts_with('!')
                        || [
                            "@license",
