                            "copyright",
                            "spdx-license-identifier:",
                            "licensed under",
                        ]
                        .into_iter()
                        .any(|marker| words.contains(marker))
                    {
                        notices.insert(match comment.kind {
                            CommentKind::Block => format!("/*{text}*/"),
                            CommentKind::Line => format!("//{text}"),
                        });
                    }

    // Return the next bytes only when the caller reads the stream.
    export async function openResource(name) {
        resourceHost ??= installResources().catch(error => {
            resourceHost = undefined;
            throw error;
        });
        return (await resourceHost).open(name);
    }
    
    async function boot() {
        const moduleLoader = new WasmLoader();
        const storageKey = "ewe.todo.pending.v1";
        const encoder = new TextEncoder(), decoder = new TextDecoder();
        const memory = (offset, length) => new Uint8Array(moduleLoader.runtime.bridge.memory.buffer, offset, length);
        let stored;
        const params = new URL(location.href).searchParams;
        const notice = document.querySelector("#notice");
        const app = createApp({
            moduleLoader, moduleUrl: "/module.wasm", start: "init_todo_host",
            view: "todos", mount: document.querySelector("#page"),
            initialRoute: params.has("count") ? "/open-count" : "/initial",
            viewDataAction: "host:apply_todo_delivery",
            transport: params.has("socket") ? {socket: "/socket"} : params.has("rpc") ? connectSender : undefined,
            onError(error) { notice.value = error.code; console.error(error); },
            imports: {
                ewe_todo_storage_size() {
                    try { stored = encoder.encode(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) ?? ""); return stored.length; }
                    catch { return -1; }
                },
                ewe_todo_storage_read(offset, length) {
                    if (!stored || stored.length !== length) return -1;
                    memory(offset, length).set(stored); stored = undefined; return 0;
                },
                ewe_todo_storage_save(offset, length) {
                    try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, decoder.decode(memory(offset, length))); return 0; }
                    catch { return -1; }
                },
            },
        });
    
        await app.boot();
        window.todoReady = true;
    }
    boot().catch(error => {
        document.querySelector("#notice").value = error?.message ?? String(error);
        console.error(error);
    });

        ## Feature 37 browser startup
        
        Todo now calls createApp with its view, initial route, delivery action, and transport selection.
        The framework installs the browser host, registers Rust actions, negotiates the connection, and opens the view.
        A separate browser application used default and custom transports in Chrome.

        cat >> specifications/69-foundation-ui-v2/learnings.md <<'EOF'
        
        ## Browser host registration
        
        The Rust builder can publish its action declarations before it transfers the registry to the dispatcher.
        The browser can then install a fresh registry for each startup attempt.
        A failed handshake can occur after the runtime attaches a view and a transport.
        The caller can retry the same application after the runtime releases both resources.

    fn emit(

        source: Lrc<SourceMap>,
        notices: &BTreeSet<String>,

    ) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        for notice in notices {

            bytes.push(b'\n');

        let mut emitter = Emitter {

                .with_minify(compact),
            cm: source.clone(),
            comments: None,
            wr: JsWriter::new(source, "\n", &mut bytes, None),
        };
        emitter.emit_program(program)?;
        Ok(bytes)
    }

        /// D1 batch): a failure in any statement leaves none of them applied. The
        /// default runs each statement in turn and is not atomic.
        async fn execute_batch_statements(
            &self,
            statements: &[(String, Vec<DataValue>)],

            for (sql, params) in statements {

        /// | `TursoStorage`, `LibsqlStore` | yes (one `DELETE ... RETURNING`) |

                .await
                .map_err(|e| StorageError::Backend(format!("KV get failed: {e:?}")))?;
    
            if result.is_null() || result.is_undefined() {
                return Ok(None);
            }
    
            let value = result
                .as_string()
                .ok_or_else(|| StorageError::Serialization("KV value is not a string".to_string()))?;
    
            let deserialized: V =
                serde_json::from_str(&value).map_err(|e| StorageError::Serialization(e.to_string()))?;
    
            Ok(Some(deserialized))
        }
    
        /// Set a key-value pair.
        async fn set_async<V: serde::Serialize>(
            &self,
            key: &str,
            value: V,
        ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
            let prefixed = self.prefixed_key(key);
            let json = serde_json::to_string(&value)
                .map_err(|e| StorageError::Serialization(e.to_string()))?;
    
            let value_js = wasm_bindgen::JsValue::from_str(&json);
            let promise = self.kv.put(&prefixed, &value_js);
            SendWrapper::new(JsFuture::from(promise))
                .await
                .map_err(|e| StorageError::Backend(format!("KV put failed: {e:?}")))?;
    
            Ok(())
        }
    
        /// Delete a key.
        async fn delete_async(&self, key: &str) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
            let prefixed = self.prefixed_key(key);
            let promise = self.kv.delete(&prefixed);
            SendWrapper::new(JsFuture::from(promise))
                .await
                .map_err(|e| StorageError::Backend(format!("KV delete failed: {e:?}")))?;
    
            Ok(())
        }
    
        /// Check if a key exists.
        async fn exists_async(&self, key: &str) -> Result<bool, StorageError> {
            let prefixed = self.prefixed_key(key);
            let promise = self.kv.get(&prefixed);
            let result = SendWrapper::new(JsFuture::from(promise))
                .await
                .map_err(|e| StorageError::Backend(format!("KV get failed: {e:?}")))?;
    
            Ok(!result.is_null() && !result.is_undefined())
        }
    
        /// List all keys with optional prefix filter.
        async fn list_keys_async(&self, prefix: Option<&str>) -> Result<Vec<String>, StorageError> {
            // KV list returns { keys: [{name: "..."}], cursor: "..." }
            let opts = Object::new();
    
            if let Some(p) = prefix {
                js_sys::Reflect::set(&opts, &"prefix".into(), &wasm_bindgen::JsValue::from_str(p))
                    .map_err(|e| StorageError::Backend(format!("KV list opts failed: {e:?}")))?;
            }
    
            let promise = self.kv.list(&opts.into());
            let result = SendWrapper::new(JsFuture::from(promise))
                .await
                .map_err(|e| StorageError::Backend(format!("KV list failed: {e:?}")))?;
    
            let obj = result
                .dyn_into::<js_sys::Object>()
                .map_err(|_| StorageError::Backend("KV list returned non-object".to_string()))?;
    
            let keys_arr = js_sys::Reflect::get(&obj, &"keys".into())
                .ok()
                .and_then(|v| v.dyn_into::<js_sys::Array>().ok())
                .unwrap_or_default();
    
            let mut keys = Vec::new();
            for i in 0..keys_arr.length() {
                let entry = keys_arr.get(i);
                if let Ok(entry_obj) = entry.dyn_into::<js_sys::Object>() {
                    if let Some(name) = js_sys::Reflect::get(&entry_obj, &"name".into())
                        .ok()
                        .and_then(|v| v.as_string())
                    {
                        // Strip prefix to return clean key
                        let clean_key = name
                            .strip_prefix(&format!("{}:", self.prefix))
                            .unwrap_or(&name)
                            .to_string();
                        keys.push(clean_key);
                    }
                }
            }
    
            Ok(keys)
        }
    }
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait]
    impl KeyValueStore for KVWasmStorage {
        async fn get<V: serde::de::DeserializeOwned + Send + 'static>(
            &self,
            key: &str,
        ) -> StorageResult<Option<V>> {
            foundation_compact::SendWrapper::new(async move { self.get_async(key).await }).await
        }
    
        async fn set<V: serde::Serialize + Send + 'static>(
            &self,
            key: &str,
            value: V,
        ) -> StorageResult<()> {
            foundation_compact::SendWrapper::new(async move { self.set_async(key, value).await }).await
        }
    
        async fn delete(&self, key: &str) -> StorageResult<()> {
            foundation_compact::SendWrapper::new(async move { self.delete_async(key).await }).await
        }
    
        async fn exists(&self, key: &str) -> StorageResult<bool> {
            foundation_compact::SendWrapper::new(async move { self.exists_async(key).await }).await
        }
    
        async fn list_keys(&self, prefix: Option<&str>) -> StorageResult<AsyncListStream> {
            let keys =
                foundation_compact::SendWrapper::new(async move { self.list_keys_async(prefix).await })
                    .await?;
            Ok(AsyncListStream::new(futures_lite::stream::iter(
                keys.into_iter().map(Ok),
            )))
        }
    }

    //! Error types for `foundation_db` storage operations.
    //!
    //! All error types use `derive_more::From` for automatic conversions
    //! and manual `impl Display` for error messages.
    
    use derive_more::From;
    
    /// Which side of a store's read/write connection lock a call wanted.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum LockMode {
        /// Shared: reads and read-only raw statements.
        Read,
        /// Exclusive: writes, raw statements that may write, and batches.
        Write,
    }
    
    impl core::fmt::Display for LockMode {
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
            match self {
                Self::Read => f.write_str("read"),
                Self::Write => f.write_str("write"),
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// Main error type for storage operations.
    ///
    /// Uses `derive_more::From` for automatic `From<T>` impls on nested
    /// error variants. String-wrapping variants use `#[from(ignore)]`.
    #[derive(From, Debug)]
    pub enum StorageError {
        /// Backend-specific error.
        #[from(ignore)]
        Backend(String),
    
        /// Connection failed.
        #[from(ignore)]
        Connection(String),
    
        /// Key not found.
        #[from(ignore)]
        NotFound(String),
    
        /// Serialization error.
        #[from(ignore)]
        Serialization(String),
    
        /// Deserialization error.
        #[from(ignore)]
        Deserialization(String),
    
        /// Encryption error.
        #[from(ignore)]
        Encryption(String),
    
        /// Migration error.
        #[from(ignore)]
        Migration(String),
    
        /// Generic storage error.
        #[from(ignore)]
        Generic(String),
    
        /// SQL conversion error.
        #[from(ignore)]
        SqlConversion(String),
    
        /// A conditional write's precondition failed (e.g. `If-None-Match: *`
        /// against an existing object, or a stale `If-Match` `ETag`).
        #[from(ignore)]
        PreconditionFailed(String),
    
        /// A store's connection lock was not free in time. See `lock_timeout` on
        /// the store: a task that holds a row stream and then calls another
        /// operation on the same store waits for itself, and gets this error
        /// instead of hanging.
        #[from(ignore)]
        LockTimeout {
            /// Which side of the lock was wanted.
            mode: LockMode,
            /// How long the call waited.
            waited: std::time::Duration,
        },
    
        /// I/O error during filesystem operations.
        Io(std::io::Error),
    
        /// JSON serialization/deserialization error.
        Json(serde_json::Error),
    
        /// Base64 decoding error.
        Base64(base64::DecodeError),
    
        /// Hex decoding error.
        Hex(hex::FromHexError),
    
        /// Turso error.
        #[cfg(all(feature = "turso", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
        Turso(turso::Error),
    
        /// libsql error.
        #[cfg(all(feature = "libsql", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
        Libsql(libsql::Error),
    }

    //! Connect each Rust child call to its browser view.
    extern crate std;
    use super::{take_request, BTreeMap, RefCell, Vec};
    use alloc::boxed::Box;
    use alloc::string::{String, ToString};
    use core::cell::Cell;
    use foundation_ui_runtime::action::{ActionError, ChildActionCaller};
    use foundation_ui_wire::{
        writer::{write_messages, ClientCaps, FrameHeader, WriterConfig},
        ErrorCode, MessageT,
    };
    
    pub(super) struct BrowserCaller(pub u64);
    type Reply = Result<(), ActionError>;
    
    std::thread_local! {
        static NEXT: Cell<u64> = const { Cell::new(0) };
        static WAITING: RefCell<BTreeMap<u64, async_channel::Sender<Reply>>> = const { RefCell::new(BTreeMap::new()) };
    }
    
    struct Pending(u64);
    impl Drop for Pending {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            WAITING.with_borrow_mut(|calls| calls.remove(&self.0));
        }
    }
    
    fn failure(message: impl Into<String>) -> ActionError {
        ActionError::new(ErrorCode::ActionFailed, message)
    }
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait(?Send)]
    impl ChildActionCaller for BrowserCaller {
        async fn call(&self, reference: &str, json: Vec<u8>, preview: Vec<MessageT>) -> Reply {
            let bytes = if preview.is_empty() {
                Vec::new()
            } else {
                let header = FrameHeader {
                    stream_id: 0,
                    sequence_id: 0,
                    ack: 0,
                };
                write_messages(
                    preview,
                    &ClientCaps::web_current(),
                    header,
                    &WriterConfig::default(),
                )
                .map_err(|error| failure(error.to_string()))?
                .0
            };
            let id = NEXT
                .with(|next| {
                    let id = next.get().checked_add(1)?;
                    next.set(id);
                    Some(id)
                })
                .ok_or_else(|| failure("Child request identifiers exhausted"))?;
            let (send, receive) = async_channel::bounded(1);
            WAITING.with_borrow_mut(|calls| calls.insert(id, send));
            let _pending = Pending(id);
            #[link(wasm_import_module = "env")]
            extern "C" {
                fn ewe_ui_child(
                    parent: u64,
                    id: u64,
                    name: *const u8,
                    name_len: usize,
                    json: *const u8,
                    json_len: usize,
                    preview: *const u8,
                    preview_len: usize,
                );
            }
            // The browser copies all three slices before the import returns.
            unsafe {
                ewe_ui_child(
                    self.0,
                    id,
                    reference.as_ptr(),
                    reference.len(),
                    json.as_ptr(),
                    json.len(),
                    bytes.as_ptr(),
                    bytes.len(),
                )
            };
            receive
                .recv()
                .await
                .map_err(|_| failure("The browser action service closed"))?
        }
    }
    
    /// Complete one child call. Consume the error slot even when the caller has closed.
    #[no_mangle]
    pub extern "C" fn ewe_ui_child_done(id: u64, code: i32, slot: u64) {
        let result = if code < 0 {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            let message = take_request(slot)
                .and_then(|bytes| String::from_utf8(bytes).ok())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Browser action failed".into());
            Err(ActionError::new(
                ErrorCode(u16::try_from(code).unwrap_or(ErrorCode::ActionFailed.0)),
                message,
            ))
        };
        if let Some(sender) = WAITING.with_borrow_mut(|calls| calls.remove(&id)) {
            // A cancelled action has already dropped its receiver.
            let _ = sender.try_send(result);
        }
    }

    impl core::fmt::Display for StorageError {
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
            match self {
                Self::Backend(s) => write!(f, "Backend error: {s}"),
                Self::Connection(s) => write!(f, "Connection failed: {s}"),
                Self::NotFound(s) => write!(f, "Key not found: {s}"),
                Self::Serialization(s) => write!(f, "Serialization error: {s}"),
                Self::Deserialization(s) => write!(f, "Deserialization error: {s}"),
                Self::Encryption(s) => write!(f, "Encryption error: {s}"),
                Self::Migration(s) => write!(f, "Migration error: {s}"),
                Self::Generic(s) => write!(f, "Storage error: {s}"),
                Self::SqlConversion(s) => write!(f, "SQL conversion error: {s}"),
                Self::PreconditionFailed(s) => write!(f, "Precondition failed: {s}"),
                Self::LockTimeout { mode, waited } => write!(
                    f,
                    "Lock timeout: the {mode} lock was not free after {waited:?}; \

                ),
                Self::Io(e) => write!(f, "IO error: {e}"),
                Self::Json(e) => write!(f, "JSON error: {e}"),
                Self::Base64(e) => write!(f, "Base64 error: {e}"),

                #[cfg(all(feature = "turso", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
                Self::Turso(e) => write!(f, "Turso error: {e}"),
                #[cfg(all(feature = "libsql", not(target_family = "wasm")))]
                Self::Libsql(e) => write!(f, "libsql error: {e}"),
            }

    //! Foundation DB - Unified Storage Backend
    //!
    //! # Architecture
    //!
    //! - **`core/`** — shared between native and wasm (traits, errors, memory backends,
    //!   D1/R2 HTTP backends, schema, crypto, cleanup)
    //! - **`native/`** — non-wasm targets, plus wasm with the WebAssembly System
    //!   Interface (WASI) for `json_file` (turso, libsql, `json_file`, `rows_stream`)
    //! - **`wasm/`** — wasm32 only (CF D1/R2/KV wasm-bindgen bindings)
    //!
    //! # Storage Providers
    //!
    //! - Turso - `SQLite`-compatible embedded/remote database with sync API
    //! - libsql - Local/remote `SQLite` with sync API
    //! - Cloudflare D1 - Edge `SQLite` for Cloudflare Workers
    //! - Cloudflare R2 - Object storage for larger blobs
    //! - In-Memory - Ephemeral storage for development/testing
    //! - JSON File - Simple JSON-on-disk key-value store (native and WASI)
    
    // The `turso` crate's async methods nest past the default trait-solver
    // recursion limit (128). `TursoStorage::set` (an `async_trait` impl) resolves
    // `Send`/`CoerceUnsized` through that chain and overflows it (issue #159228,
    // `recursion_depth_exceeding_limit`). Raise the limit instead of flattening the
    // chain: the depth is in the external `turso` dependency, not here.
    #![recursion_limit = "256"]
    
    // Shared — always compiled
    pub mod core;
    
    // Central storage provider (wraps all backends)
    pub mod storage_provider;
    
    // Native — TCP/DB backends, rows streaming. `json_file` also needs only
    // filesystem access, which a wasm target with WASI has.
    #[cfg(json_file_backend)]
    pub mod native;
    
    // Wasm — optional wasm-bindgen bridge for Cloudflare Workers (D1/R2/KV)
    #[cfg(all(target_family = "wasm", feature = "wasm-bindgen-bindings"))]
    pub mod wasm;
    
    // A file system with no files, for a runner whose groups are all in code or
    // embedded. Re-exported from `foundation_vfs` for the callers of a migration
    // runner that reads no directory.
    pub use foundation_vfs::EmptyFs;

        // Keep one application namespace in each database. Close the connection after each operation.
        async function openDatabase(namespace) {
            const request = indexedDB.open("ewe.kv." + namespace, 1);
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                request.onupgradeneeded = () => request.result.createObjectStore("records");
                request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
                request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
            });
        }
        
        async function indexedOperation(namespace, operation, key, value, after, limit) {
            const database = await openDatabase(namespace);
            try {
                return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                    const writes = operation === "set" || operation === "delete";
                    const tx = database.transaction("records", writes ? "readwrite" : "readonly");
                    const records = tx.objectStore("records");
                    let result = null;
                    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(result);
                    tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error ?? new DOMException("Storage transaction aborted", "AbortError"));
                    if (operation === "list") {
                        const page = [];
                        result = page;
                        const cursor = records.openKeyCursor(IDBKeyRange.lowerBound(after ?? key, after != null));
                        cursor.onsuccess = () => {
                            const entry = cursor.result;
                            if (!entry || !entry.key.startsWith(key)) return;
                            page.push(entry.key);
                            if (page.length < limit) entry.continue();
                        };
                    } else if (operation === "get") {
                        const request = records.get(key);
                        request.onsuccess = () => { result = request.result ?? null; };
                    } else if (operation === "exists") {
                        const request = records.count(key);
                        request.onsuccess = () => { result = request.result !== 0; };
                    } else if (operation === "set") records.put(value, key);
                    else if (operation === "delete") records.delete(key);
                    else throw new TypeError("Unknown storage operation");
                });
            } finally {
                database.close();
            }
        }
        
        function localOperation(namespace, operation, key, value, after, limit) {
            const storage = globalThis.localStorage;
            const scope = "ewe.kv." + JSON.stringify(namespace) + ":";
            switch (operation) {
                case "get": return storage.getItem(scope + key);
                case "exists": return storage.getItem(scope + key) !== null;
                case "set": storage.setItem(scope + key, value); return null;
                case "delete": storage.removeItem(scope + key); return null;
                case "list": {
                    // Web Storage does not provide sorted iteration. Keep the next page in key order.
                    const page = [];
                    for (let i = 0; i < storage.length; i++) {
                        const entry = storage.key(i);
                        if (!entry?.startsWith(scope + key)) continue;
                        const name = entry.slice(scope.length);
                        if (after != null && name <= after) continue;
                        if (page.length === limit && name >= page[limit - 1]) continue;
                        const index = page.findIndex(item => item > name);
                        page.splice(index < 0 ? page.length : index, 0, name);
                        if (page.length > limit) page.pop();
                    }
                    return page;
                }
                default: throw new TypeError("Unknown storage operation");
            }
        }
        
        export async function browserOperation(indexed, namespace, operation, key, value, after, limit) {
            const run = indexed ? indexedOperation : localOperation;
            return run(namespace, operation, key, value, after, limit);
        }

        cat > backends/foundation_db/src/wasm/browser.rs <<'EOF'
        //! Browser key-value storage. Each store owns one application namespace.
        use crate::core::errors::{StorageError, StorageResult};
        use crate::core::storage_provider::{AsyncListStream, KeyValueStore};
        use foundation_compact::SendWrapper;
        use futures_util::{TryStreamExt, stream};
        use serde::{Serialize, de::DeserializeOwned};
        use std::num::NonZeroU32;
        use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
        
        #[wasm_bindgen(module = "/src/wasm/browser_storage.js")]
        extern "C" {
            #[wasm_bindgen(catch, js_name = browserOperation)]
            async fn operation(indexed: bool, namespace: &str, op: &str, key: &str, value: Option<String>, after: Option<String>, limit: u32) -> Result<JsValue, JsValue>;
        }
        
        /// Select the browser database or the origin's local settings store.
        #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
        pub enum BrowserBackend {
            IndexedDb,
            LocalStorage,
        }
        
        /// Store serialized records under independent keys. Clones share the namespace.
        #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
        pub struct BrowserStore {
            backend: BrowserBackend,
            namespace: String,
            page_size: NonZeroU32,
        }
        
        impl BrowserStore {
            /// Open a namespace. Key streams fetch 100 names per page by default.
            pub fn new(backend: BrowserBackend, namespace: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
                Self { backend, namespace: namespace.into(), page_size: NonZeroU32::new(100).unwrap() }
            }
        
            /// Set the maximum number of names kept in a key stream page.
            pub fn with_page_size(mut self, size: NonZeroU32) -> Self {
                self.page_size = size;
                self
            }
        
            async fn request(&self, op: &str, key: &str, value: Option<String>, after: Option<String>) -> StorageResult<JsValue> {
                SendWrapper::new(operation(matches!(self.backend, BrowserBackend::IndexedDb), &self.namespace, op, key, value, after, self.page_size.get()))
                    .await.map_err(|error| {
                        let field = |name: &str| js_sys::Reflect::get(&error, &name.into()).ok().and_then(|v| v.as_string());
                        StorageError::Browser { name: field("name").unwrap_or_else(|| "Error".into()), message: field("message").unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{error:?}")) }
                    })
            }
        }
        
        #[async_trait::async_trait]
        impl KeyValueStore for BrowserStore {
            async fn get<V: DeserializeOwned + Send + 'static>(&self, key: &str) -> StorageResult<Option<V>> {
                let value = self.request("get", key, None, None).await?;
                if value.is_null() { return Ok(None); }
                let json = value.as_string().ok_or_else(|| StorageError::Deserialization("Expected a stored string".into()))?;
                Ok(Some(serde_json::from_str(&json)?))
            }
        
            async fn set<V: Serialize + Send + 'static>(&self, key: &str, value: V) -> StorageResult<()> {
                self.request("set", key, Some(serde_json::to_string(&value)?), None).await?;
                Ok(())
            }
        
            async fn exists(&self, key: &str) -> StorageResult<bool> {
                self.request("exists", key, None, None).await?.as_bool().ok_or_else(|| StorageError::Backend("Expected a presence flag".into()))
            }
        
            async fn delete(&self, key: &str) -> StorageResult<()> {
                self.request("delete", key, None, None).await?;
                Ok(())
            }
        
            async fn list_keys(&self, prefix: Option<&str>) -> StorageResult<AsyncListStream> {
                let state = (self.clone(), prefix.unwrap_or_default().to_owned(), None);
                let pages = stream::try_unfold(state, |(store, prefix, after)| async move {
                    let response = store.request("list", &prefix, None, after).await?;
                    let keys = response.dyn_into::<js_sys::Array>()
                        .map_err(|_| StorageError::Backend("Expected a page of keys".into()))?
                        .iter().map(|v| v.as_string().ok_or_else(|| StorageError::Deserialization("Expected a string key".into())))
                        .collect::<StorageResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let Some(last) = keys.last().cloned() else { return Ok(None); };
                    Ok(Some((stream::iter(keys.into_iter().map(Ok)), (store, prefix, Some(last)))))
                });
                Ok(AsyncListStream::new(pages.try_flatten()))
            }
        }

    # wasm32. Run it inside workerd on the real local bindings:

    #     --profile uat --bin wasm-testbed -- test bindgen-wrangler \
    #     backends/foundation_db/integration/wasm_cf

    # The testbed's worker passes the real `env` (D1, R2 and KV bindings from its
    # `wrangler.toml`) as `globalThis.__CF_TEST_ENV__`.

        build: &build::BuildOutput,
        integration_dir: &std::path::Path,
        browser: &cli::Browser,
        headless: bool,
        filter: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<(), ErrorTrace<WasmTestbedError>> {
        use error::{ToTrace, WasmTestbedError};
        use wasm::BindgenTarget;
    
        tracing::info!("Running wasm-bindgen (web)...");
        // Pass --out-name so the output is {name}.js / {name}_bg.wasm (no hash).
        // The deno mode already does this; without it, the hashed input filename
        // becomes the output name and the index.html/run.js imports don't resolve.
        wasm::run_wasm_bindgen_with_name(
            &build.wasm_path,
            integration_dir,
            BindgenTarget::Web,
            Some(&build.package_name),
        )?;
    
        // The page imports the glue's `init`, which returns the wasm exports, so
        // the glue does not need an extra export. Its start call must still go:
        // that start is libtest's `main`, which aborts the module before a case.
        let js_file = integration_dir.join(format!("{}.js", build.package_name));
        wasm::patch_bindgen_glue(&js_file, false)?;
    
        init::write_template_to(
            "bindgen-web/index.html",
            &build.package_name,
            integration_dir,
        )?;
    
        let bg_wasm = integration_dir.join(format!("{}_bg.wasm", build.package_name));
        let mut tests = wasm_test::discover_tests(&bg_wasm)?;
        if let Some(filter) = filter {
            tests.retain(|name| name.contains(filter));
        }
        if tests.is_empty() {
            return Err(WasmTestbedError::NoFwtCases(bg_wasm.display().to_string()).trace());
        }
        tracing::info!("Discovered {} tests", tests.len());
    
        init::write_bindgen_runjs_to(
            "bindgen-web/run.js",
            &build.package_name,
            &tests,
            integration_dir,
        )?;
    
        let server = server::start_serving(integration_dir)?;
        let url = server.url("index.html");
        tracing::info!("Serving at {}", url);
    
        let output = browser::run(
            &url,
            browser,
            headless,
            &foundation_context::Ctx::host(),
            &browser::BrowserRunLimits::default(),
        )?;
        tracing::info!("Test output: {}", output.output);
    
        server.shutdown();
        // The page cannot set an exit code: the last `test result:` line is the
        // verdict. A page that printed none is not a pass.
        let summary = output.test_result.trim().to_string();
        if !summary.contains("test result:") {
            return Err(WasmTestbedError::MissingTestSummary(summary).trace());
        }
        if !summary.starts_with("test result: ok") {
            let failed = failed_count(&summary);
            // The whole page text names the failing cases (issue #588).
            return Err(WasmTestbedError::CaseFailures {
                failed,
                output: output.output,
            }
            .trace());
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub enum PendingChange {

            #[serde(alias = "creation_id")]
            id: super::TodoId,
            title: String,
        },
        Delete {
            id: super::TodoId,
        },
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Pending {
        pub change: PendingChange,
        pub retry: bool,
        #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
        pub validation: Option<String>,
    }
    
    type Entries = BTreeMap<String, Pending>;
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait]
    pub trait PendingStorage: Send + Sync {
        async fn load(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String>;
        async fn save(&self, contents: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), String>;
    }
    
    #[derive(Default)]
    pub(super) struct MemoryStorage(Mutex<Vec<u8>>);
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait]
    impl PendingStorage for MemoryStorage {
        async fn load(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
            Ok(self
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner)
                .clone())
        }
        async fn save(&self, contents: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), String> {
            *self
                .0
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner) = contents;
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    
    struct Outbox {
        storage: Arc<dyn PendingStorage>,
        initialized: futures_util::lock::Mutex<bool>,
    }
    
    /// Install the storage selected by this host.
    pub fn install_pending_storage(ctx: &Ctx, storage: Arc<dyn PendingStorage>) {
        ctx.store(Outbox {
            storage,
            initialized: futures_util::lock::Mutex::new(false),
        });
    }

        //! Standalone browser storage consumer for the cross-tab tests.
        use foundation_db::core::storage_provider::KeyValueStore;
        use foundation_db::wasm::browser::{BrowserBackend, BrowserStore};
        use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
        
        #[wasm_bindgen]
        pub async fn record(indexed: bool, namespace: String, key: String, value: Option<String>) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
            let store = store(indexed, &namespace);
            match value {
                Some(title) => store.set(&key, title).await,
                None => store.delete(&key).await,
            }.map_err(|error| JsValue::from_str(&error.to_string()))
        }
        
        #[wasm_bindgen]
        pub async fn entries(indexed: bool, namespace: String) -> Result<String, JsValue> {
            async fn read(store: BrowserStore) -> foundation_db::core::errors::StorageResult<String> {
                let keys = store.list_keys(Some("pending/")).await?.collect_all().await?;
                let mut rows = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
                for key in keys {
                    if let Some(value) = store.get::<String>(&key).await? {
                        rows.insert(key, value);
                    }
                }
                Ok(serde_json::to_string(&rows)?)
            }
            read(store(indexed, &namespace)).await.map_err(|error| JsValue::from_str(&error.to_string()))
        }
        
        fn store(indexed: bool, namespace: &str) -> BrowserStore {
            let backend = if indexed { BrowserBackend::IndexedDb } else { BrowserBackend::LocalStorage };
            BrowserStore::new(backend, namespace).with_page_size(1.try_into().unwrap())
        }
        EOF

        use foundation_db::core::storage_provider::KeyValueStore;
        use foundation_db::wasm::browser::{BrowserBackend, BrowserStore};
        use wasm_bindgen_test::wasm_bindgen_test;
        
        #[wasm_bindgen_test]
        async fn both_stores_keep_independent_keys_and_namespaces() {
            for backend in [BrowserBackend::IndexedDb, BrowserBackend::LocalStorage] {
                let store = BrowserStore::new(backend, "browser:test").with_page_size(1.try_into().unwrap());
                let other = BrowserStore::new(backend, "browser:test:other");
                other.set("todo:b", 9).await.unwrap();
                store.set("other", true).await.unwrap();
                store.set("todo:b", vec![1, 2]).await.unwrap();
                store.set("todo:a", vec![3, 4]).await.unwrap();
                assert_eq!(store.list_keys(Some("todo:")).await.unwrap().collect_all().await.unwrap(), ["todo:a", "todo:b"]);
                assert_eq!(store.get::<Vec<i32>>("todo:b").await.unwrap(), Some(vec![1, 2]));
                assert!(store.exists("todo:b").await.unwrap());
                store.delete("todo:b").await.unwrap();
                assert!(!store.exists("todo:b").await.unwrap());
                assert_eq!(other.get::<i32>("todo:b").await.unwrap(), Some(9));
                store.delete("todo:a").await.unwrap();
                store.delete("other").await.unwrap();
                other.delete("todo:b").await.unwrap();
            }
        }
        EOF

    // Run against a repository HTTP server and an isolated, graphics-capable Chrome.
    import assert from "node:assert/strict";
    import {spawn} from "node:child_process";
    import {once} from "node:events";
    import {mkdtemp, rm} from "node:fs/promises";
    import {tmpdir} from "node:os";
    import {join} from "node:path";
    import {createInterface} from "node:readline";
    
    const [chromePath, baseUrl] = process.argv.slice(2);
    if (!chromePath || !baseUrl) throw Error("Pass the Chrome executable path and repository server URL");
    const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(),"ewe-gpu-"));
    const chrome = spawn(chromePath,["--headless=new","--no-first-run","--enable-unsafe-webgpu",
      "--remote-debugging-port=0","--user-data-dir="+directory,"about:blank"], {detached: true, stdio: ["ignore", "ignore", "pipe"]});
    const exited = once(chrome,"exit");
    let socket;
    try {
      let endpoint;
      for await (const line of createInterface({input:chrome.stderr})) {
        const match = line.match(/DevTools listening on (.*)/);
        if (match) { endpoint = new URL(match[1]); break; }
      }
      assert.ok(endpoint, "Chrome did not open its debugging port");
      const pages = await (await fetch("http://"+endpoint.host+"/json/list")).json();
      socket = new WebSocket(pages.find(page => page.type === "page").webSocketDebuggerUrl);
      await once(socket,"open");
      let sequence = 0;
      const pending = new Map();
      socket.onmessage = event => {
        const message = JSON.parse(event.data);
        pending.get(message.id)?.(message);
        pending.delete(message.id);
      };
      async function call(method, params = {}) {
        const id = ++sequence;
        let timeout;
        const reply = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          pending.set(id, resolve);
          timeout = setTimeout(() => reject(Error(`Chrome did not complete ${method}`)), 30_000);
        });
        try {
          socket.send(JSON.stringify({id,method,params}));
          const response = await reply;
          if (response.error) throw Error(JSON.stringify(response.error));
          return response.result;
        } finally {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
          pending.delete(id);
        }
      }
      async function evaluate(expression) {
        const result = await call("Runtime.evaluate",{expression,awaitPromise:true,returnByValue:true});
        if (result.exceptionDetails) throw Error(result.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? result.exceptionDetails.text);
        return result.result.value;
      }
      await call("Page.enable");

        /// `https` is true the server speaks TLS with the bundled localhost dev cert.
        ///
        /// # Errors
        /// [`BrowserError::Io`] if the listener can't bind; [`BrowserError::Launch`]
        /// if the TLS acceptor can't be built or the server thread can't spawn.
        pub fn start(
            bind: &str,
            page: PageSource,
            statics: &[StaticMount],
            mut headers: Vec<(String, String)>,
            encoding: Encoding,
            https: bool,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            let listener = TcpListener::bind(bind)?;
            let addr = listener.local_addr()?;
    
            headers.push(("X-Primal-Encoding".into(), encoding.token().into()));
            let page_state = Arc::new(PageState {
                page: Mutex::new(page),
                headers,
            });
            let broadcaster = Broadcaster::new();
            let live = LiveChannel::new(1, BacklogConfig::default(), WriterConfig::default());
    
            let mut app = HttpApp::new_serve();
            // PageState + Broadcaster are read out of the ctx by the handlers; the
            // Arc/clone share the same state the TestServer holds.
            app.context().store(SharedState(page_state.clone()));
            app.context().store(broadcaster.clone());
            app.context().store(live.clone());
            app.route_any::<PageHandler>("/");
            app.route_any::<crate::test::stream::RawStreamHandler>(STREAM_PATH);
            app.route_any::<StreamHandler>("/__primal/live");

            // bytes + content type, register on a path. No per-asset Serve impl.

            let js_ct = format!("{js_type}; charset=utf-8");
            let runtime: Arc<dyn Serve> = Arc::new(StaticAssetHandler::new(
                RUNTIME_JS.as_bytes(),
                js_ct.as_str(),
            ));
            let primal_test: Arc<dyn Serve> = Arc::new(StaticAssetHandler::new(
                PRIMAL_TEST_JS.as_bytes(),
                js_ct.as_str(),

                ("foundation-ui-recovery.js", FOUNDATION_UI_RECOVERY_JS),
                ("foundation-ui-connections.js", FOUNDATION_UI_CONNECTIONS_JS),
                ("foundation-ui-wire.js", FOUNDATION_UI_WIRE_JS),
                ("foundation-ui-vocab.js", FOUNDATION_UI_VOCAB_JS),
                ("foundation-ui-behaviours.js", FOUNDATION_UI_BEHAVIOURS_JS),
            ] {
                let handler: Arc<dyn Serve> =
                    Arc::new(StaticAssetHandler::new(source.as_bytes(), js_ct.as_str()));
    
            Ok(Self {
                addr,
                https,
                page: page_state,
                broadcaster,
                live,
                shutdown,
                handle: Some(handle),
            })
        }

    [package]
    name = "foundation_browser"
    version = "0.0.9"
    edition.workspace = true
    rust-version.workspace = true
    license.workspace = true
    authors.workspace = true
    repository.workspace = true
    description = "Pure-Rust browser test driver (CDP) — speak the browser's JSON-RPC protocol directly from Rust"
    keywords = ["browser", "cdp", "testing", "foundation", "chromium"]
    
    [dependencies]
    # `multi` is REQUIRED: foundation_netio's native WebSocket client is
    # `#[cfg(feature = "multi")]`, and we want the valtron multi-threaded executor
    # (all CPU threads) driving the browser sockets. multi → foundation_core/multi.
    foundation_core = { path = "../foundation_core", version = "0.0.23", features = ["multi"] }
    foundation_context = { path = "../foundation_context", version = "0.0.4" }
    foundation_compact = { path = "../foundation_compact", version = "0.2.7" }
    foundation_netio = { path = "../foundation_netio", version = "0.0.15", features = ["multi"] }
    # ssl-rustls-ring: the TestServer can serve HTTPS (the `https` mode) using a
    # bundled localhost dev cert — for testing secure-context features.
    foundation_http = { path = "../foundation_http", version = "0.0.13", features = ["ssl-rustls-ring"] }
    foundation_macros = { workspace = true }
    foundation_wasm = { path = "../foundation_wasm", version = "0.0.11" }
    # embedded-js exposes the runtime assets (foundation-wasm-ui.js) as consts so we
    # serve <mount-stream> without a build step.
    foundation_wasm_ui = { path = "../foundation_wasm_ui", version = "0.1.11", features = ["embedded-js"] }
    foundation_ui_http = { workspace = true, features = ["live-stream"] }
    foundation_ui_wire = { path = "../foundation_ui_wire", version = "0.0.7" }
    
    serde = { workspace = true }
    serde_json = { workspace = true }
    derive_more = { workspace = true }
    tracing = { workspace = true }
    base64 = "0.22"
    # Holds the dev TLS key zeroized in memory, matching the SSLAcceptor::from_pem API.
    zeroize = { workspace = true }
    
    [features]
    # Integration tests that require a real Chromium binary opt into this so CI

    browser-tests = []
    
    [dev-dependencies]
    # `test-clock` supplies `SimulatedClock` for the injection test.
    foundation_core = { path = "../foundation_core", version = "0.0.23", features = ["test-clock"] }
